units.title: A New Start

lines.text: How was your first day at senior high?
lines.cn: 你高中第一天过得怎么样?

lines.text: Great, but I felt really nervous when I introduced myself.
lines.cn: 很棒,不过自我介绍时我特别紧张。

lines.text: Me too! Did anything funny happen?
lines.cn: 我也是!发生什么好笑的事了吗?

lines.text: Yes. My name was the same as the teacher's, and everyone laughed. His kind words made me feel relaxed.
lines.cn: 有啊。我和老师同名,大家都笑了。他温和的话让我放松了下来。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 基本句型(Basic sentence structures:主谓/主谓宾/主谓宾宾/主谓宾补)

units.grammarTitle: 基本句型(Basic sentence structures:主谓/主谓宾/主谓宾宾/主谓宾补)

reading.passage: Starting senior high is a brand-new chapter. The first weeks may feel hard, but if you stay calm, join in and help others, every challenge becomes a chance to grow.
reading.passageCn: 升入高中是全新的篇章。最初的几周也许会很艰难,但只要你保持镇定、积极参与、乐于助人,每一个挑战都会变成成长的机会。

questions.q: How may the first weeks of senior high feel?
What does each challenge become, according to the passage?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about your first day at senior high. Say one thing that happened, what you did, and how you felt. Try to use one SVOC sentence (e.g. made me relaxed) and one SVP sentence (e.g. I felt nervous).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写写你高中的第一天:发生了一件什么事、你怎么做的、你的感受。试着用一个'主谓宾补'句(如 made me relaxed)和一个'主系表'句(如 I felt nervous)。

quizQuestions.q: On Orientation Day, you get a great ____ to know the school.
New students often feel under ____ during the first week.
In the science club, we ____ questions about nature.
I wanted to make a good first ____ on my new teachers.
The teacher ____ us a useful book about study skills.
Mr Meng's advice made every student more ____.
Before the speech, I felt very ____.
The teacher's question made the noisy room ____.
听句子选中文:
opts: 我们一个接一个地做自我介绍。
quizQuestions.audio: We introduced ourselves to the class one by one.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 做最重要的任务时,要先列一张清单。
quizQuestions.audio: To do the most important tasks, first make a clear list.

listeningQuestions.audio: My first day at senior high was both exciting and a little scary.
opts: 我高中的第一天既兴奋又有点吓人。

listeningQuestions.audio: I joined the badminton club to stay fit and make new friends.
opts: 我加入羽毛球社来健身并结识新朋友。

listeningQuestions.audio: His kind words made me feel a lot more relaxed.
opts: 他的话让大家都生气了。
他温和的话让我放松了许多。

listeningQuestions.audio: Keep calm and be prepared, and you will make a good start.
opts: 保持镇定、做好准备,你就会有个好的开始。

listeningQuestions.audio: Orientation Day is a great chance to get to know the school.
opts: 迎新日是了解学校的好机会。

listeningQuestions.audio: I am really looking forward to the new school year.

finalReading.passage: On his first day at senior high, Daniel was too shy to talk to anyone and ate lunch alone. The next morning, instead of waiting, he smiled and said hello to the boy beside him, who turned out to love football just as much as he did. A week later, the two were practising together every day, and Daniel no longer felt like a stranger at school.

questions.q: Why did Daniel eat lunch alone on his first day?
options: He felt too nervous to speak to others.
He disliked all the food.
He had no time for lunch.
The other students left early.
questions.explanation: 原文 'too shy to talk to anyone and ate lunch alone' 的转述;其余选项原文未提。

questions.q: How did Daniel feel at school a week later?
options: Lonelier than before.
Sorry that he had spoken first.
No longer like a stranger.
Too busy to make friends.
questions.explanation: 末句 'Daniel no longer felt like a stranger at school'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。

units.title: Exploring English

lines.text: Excuse me, where is the lift?
lines.cn: 打扰一下,电梯在哪里?

lines.text: The lift? Oh, you mean the elevator. It's behind the shoe section.
lines.cn: 电梯?哦,你是说 elevator。它在鞋区后面。

lines.text: Yes! In Britain we usually call it the lift.
lines.cn: 对!在英国我们通常叫它 lift。

lines.text: Same thing, different word. English is fun, isn't it?
lines.cn: 同一样东西,不同的词。英语很有趣,对吧?

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 构词法(Word formation:派生/合成/转化)

units.grammarTitle: 构词法(Word formation:派生/合成/转化)

reading.passage: English makes new words in clever ways. We join 'home' and 'work' to get 'homework', and we add 'un-' to 'happy' to mean the opposite. Knowing these patterns helps us guess what new words mean.
reading.passageCn: 英语用巧妙的方式造新词。我们把 home 和 work 合成 homework,给 happy 加 un- 表示相反。懂得这些规律有助于我们猜出新词的意思。

questions.q: How is the word 'homework' made?
Why is it useful to know these patterns?
opts: They help us guess new words' meanings.

writing.prompt: Write about one funny misunderstanding you have had (or could have) with an English word or expression.
writing.promptCn: 写一写你(可能)因为某个英语词或表达而闹过的一个有趣误会。

quizQuestions.q: If a piece of information is not correct, we say it is ____.
Travelling by ship for the first time, she felt ____.
Remember to ____ the flowers in the garden.
An action that does no harm is completely ____.
You can often guess a word's meaning from the ____.
WTO is short for the World Trade ____.
In American English, 'first floor' ____ means the ground level.
Online forums can be a very useful learning ____.
选出与录音意思相符的一项:
opts: 美国人坐地铁叫 subway,英国人叫 underground。
美国人和英国人都叫 subway。
quizQuestions.audio: Americans ride the subway, but the British travel on the underground.

quizQuestions.q: 选出与录音意思相符的一项:
opts: selfie 是用手机给自己拍的照片。
quizQuestions.audio: A selfie is a photo that you take of yourself with a phone.

listeningQuestions.audio: There is no ham in a hamburger.
Americans put gas in their cars, but the British say petrol.
opts: 美国人说 gas,英国人说 petrol,都指汽油。
美国人和英国人都说 petrol。

listeningQuestions.audio: If you add 'un-' to 'happy', it means the opposite.
opts: 给 happy 加 un- 就表示相反的意思。
给 happy 加 un- 没有变化。

listeningQuestions.audio: 'BRB' is a short form of 'be right back'.
opts: BRB 是 be right back 的缩写。
BRB 是一个网站的名字。

listeningQuestions.audio: She had a frog in her throat and could hardly speak.
opts: 她嗓子不舒服,几乎说不出话。
她真的吞下了一只青蛙。

listeningQuestions.audio: Remember to water the flowers every morning.
opts: 记得每天早上给花浇水。

finalReading.passage: When Daniel first joined an online English forum, he kept meeting short forms like 'BRB' and 'COZ' that he could not understand. Instead of giving up, he asked his new friends what each one meant and wrote them down. A month later, he could chat easily and even guess new words from the way they were built.

questions.q: What problem did Daniel have at first on the forum?
options: He found the online abbreviations hard to make sense of.
He could not find the website at all.
He had no friends to talk to.
He could not type in English.
questions.explanation: 原文说他一开始看不懂 BRB、COZ 等缩写,为转述;其余与原文不符或未提。

questions.q: How did Daniel improve after a month?
options: He chatted comfortably and worked out new words using word formation.
He stopped using the forum completely.
He only spoke Chinese online.
He forgot all the short forms he had learned.
questions.explanation: 末句说一个月后他能轻松聊天并靠构词法猜词,为转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Family Matters

lines.text: Grandma's birthday is coming. What should we get her?
lines.cn: 奶奶的生日快到了,我们送她什么好呢?

lines.text: She loves tea, so let's buy her a nice tea set.
lines.cn: 她爱喝茶,我们买一套漂亮的茶具吧。

lines.text: Great idea! I'll also make her a birthday card by hand.
lines.cn: 好主意!我还要亲手给她做一张生日卡。

lines.text: She will be so happy to see the whole family together.
lines.cn: 看到全家团聚,她一定会非常开心。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 时态复习(一般/进行/完成:现在与过去)

units.grammarTitle: 时态复习(一般/进行/完成:现在与过去)

reading.passage: On Sundays, our whole family cooks lunch together. Dad makes the soup, Mum cuts the vegetables, and I set the table. It is the happiest hour of our week.
reading.passageCn: 每个周日,我们全家一起做午饭。爸爸煮汤,妈妈切菜,我摆桌子。这是我们一周里最快乐的时光。

questions.q: Who makes the soup in the family?
How does the family feel about cooking together?
opts: It is their happiest hour of the week.

writing.prompt: Write about a happy family memory in about 60 words. Say when it happened, what you did together, and why you treasure it.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一段快乐的家庭回忆:何时发生、你们一起做了什么、为什么你珍惜它。

quizQuestions.q: Father hopes I will choose a ____ in law like him.
Grandfather kindly helped the family ____ their argument.
There is sometimes a ____ between parents and children.
I really ____ my elder sister for her hard work.
Look! Mum ____ in the park at the moment.
Dad ____ quite a bit since we last saw him.
By the time we arrived, Grandma ____ dinner already.
We ____ the same campsite ten years ago.
What did Grandma do yesterday?
quizQuestions.audio: Grandma called us yesterday to say hello.

quizQuestions.q: What does the brother want to do after school?
quizQuestions.audio: My brother wants to focus on his music after school.

listeningQuestions.audio: Dad has grown a grey beard nowadays.
opts: 爸爸如今留起了灰白的胡子。
爸爸把胡子刮得很干净。

listeningQuestions.audio: Mum goes jogging every morning to stay fit.
opts: 妈妈每天早上去慢跑以保持健康。

listeningQuestions.audio: Grandpa plays chess with my father every Friday night.
opts: 爷爷每周五晚上和我爸爸下棋。

listeningQuestions.audio: We are throwing Grandma a big birthday party.
opts: 我们要给奶奶办一场盛大的生日派对。
我们给奶奶买了一辆车。

listeningQuestions.audio: I had a long chat with my dad about my future.
opts: 我和爸爸就我的未来长谈了一次。
我帮爸爸做了一顿晚饭。

listeningQuestions.audio: Mum apologised for missing my school show.
opts: 妈妈为错过我的校园演出道歉。

finalReading.passage: Every Sunday afternoon, Lin Tao and his grandfather play chess in the garden after lunch. Grandpa always lets him think carefully before each move, and he never laughs when Lin Tao makes a mistake. Over the years, these quiet afternoons have become Lin Tao's favourite family memory.

questions.q: What do Lin Tao and his grandfather usually do on Sunday afternoons?
options: They enjoy a game of chess in the garden.
They go jogging around the park.
They cook a big family meal.
They watch a football match on TV.
questions.explanation: 原文 'play chess in the garden after lunch' 的转述;其余活动文中未提。

questions.q: How does Grandpa treat Lin Tao when he makes a mistake?
options: He gets angry and stops the game.
He stays patient and does not laugh at him.
He refuses to play with him again.
He asks Lin Tao to leave the garden.
questions.explanation: 原文 'never laughs when Lin Tao makes a mistake' 与'lets him think carefully'的转述(覆盖短文中段)。

units.title: Friends Forever

lines.text: How do you usually make new friends?
lines.cn: 你通常怎样交新朋友?

lines.text: I like joining clubs where people share my interests.
lines.cn: 我喜欢参加兴趣相投的社团。

lines.text: That's nice. I often make friends online first, then meet them later.
lines.cn: 不错。我常先在网上交友,再见面。

lines.text: Just be careful and stay honest. That's what matters most.
lines.cn: 只要小心、保持真诚就好,这最重要。

lines.text: You look worried. What's wrong?
lines.cn: 你看起来很担心,怎么了?

lines.text: My best friend is moving away, and I'm afraid we'll lose touch.
lines.cn: 我最好的朋友要搬走了,我怕我们会失去联系。

lines.text: Don't worry. Real friends stay close, however far apart they live.
lines.cn: 别担心,真朋友无论隔多远都会亲密如初。

lines.text: You're right. We can video-call every weekend. Thanks!
lines.cn: 你说得对,我们可以每周末视频通话。谢谢!

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 定语从句1(关系代词 who/whom/which/that/whose)

units.grammarTitle: 定语从句1(关系代词 who/whom/which/that/whose)

reading.passage: Anna was new in town and felt too shy to speak to anyone. A classmate who sat next to her noticed this and invited her to have lunch together. Within a few days, the two of them had become close friends.
reading.passageCn: 安娜刚搬来,害羞得不敢和任何人说话。坐在她旁边的一位同学注意到了,便邀请她一起吃午饭。没过几天,两人就成了好朋友。

questions.q: Why was Anna too shy to speak at first?
What did the classmate do to help?
opts: She invited Anna to have lunch together.

writing.prompt: Write about 60 words to introduce your best friend: what he or she is like, and one thing that shows your friendship. Try to use 'who', 'whose' or 'that'.
writing.promptCn: 写约60词介绍你最好的朋友:他/她是怎样的人,以及一件体现你们友谊的小事。试着用上 who、whose 或 that。

quizQuestions.q: Which word means '推迟,使延期'?
In 'maintain a friendship', what does 'maintain' mean?
Which word means '焦虑的,不安的'?
What does the phrase 'lose track of' mean?
The friend ____ helped me most is very kind.
It is the only thing ____ really matters between true friends.
She is the girl ____ smile can brighten any bad day.
Friendship is a gift ____ money simply cannot buy.
What does this saying mean?
opts: 真正的朋友在你有难时帮你。
quizQuestions.audio: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

quizQuestions.q: How do the two friends plan to keep in touch?
quizQuestions.audio: We could video-call every weekend to stay close.

listeningQuestions.audio: A true friend stays with you in hard times.
opts: 真正的朋友会在困境中陪着你。
真正的朋友只在你富有时出现。

listeningQuestions.audio: Thanks to social media, we can keep in touch with faraway friends.
opts: 多亏社交媒体,我们能和远方的朋友保持联系。
我们再也见不到朋友了。

listeningQuestions.audio: She is the girl whose ideas are always inspiring.
opts: 她是那个总迟到的女孩。
她就是那个想法总能给人启发的女孩。

listeningQuestions.audio: I prefer making friends face to face rather than online.
opts: 比起网上,我更喜欢面对面交朋友。

listeningQuestions.audio: Never share private information with strangers online.
opts: 不要在网上把私人信息透露给陌生人。

listeningQuestions.audio: Saying sorry first is one of the bravest things a friend can do.
opts: 先道歉是朋友能做的最勇敢的事之一。

finalReading.passage: When Daniel changed schools, he was sure he would never find friends as close as the ones he had left behind. On his very first morning, a boy named Sam noticed him sitting alone and invited him to join a basketball game. Within a week, the two of them were laughing together as if they had known each other for years.

questions.q: What did Daniel believe when he first changed schools?
options: That he would not make such close friends again.
That he would soon become the best player.
That his old school was much worse.
That he no longer wanted any friends.
questions.explanation: 首句 'he would never find friends as close as the ones he had left behind' 的转述;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: How did Sam help Daniel feel welcome?
options: He lent him a large sum of money.
He walked him home after class.
He noticed Daniel alone and asked him to play basketball.
He helped him with all his homework.
questions.explanation: 第二句 'noticed him sitting alone and invited him to join a basketball game' 的转述(短文中段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Into the Wild

lines.text: Where would you like to go this weekend?
lines.cn: 这周末你想去哪里?

lines.text: To the park where we can watch wild eagles.
lines.cn: 去那个我们能观赏野鹰的公园。

lines.text: Great! When is the best time to see them?
lines.cn: 太好了!什么时候最适合看到它们?

lines.text: Early morning is the time when they are most active.
lines.cn: 清晨是它们最活跃的时候。

dialogues.title: Should We Keep Animals in Zoos?

lines.text: Do you think zoos are good for animals?
lines.cn: 你觉得动物园对动物好吗?

lines.text: A good zoo can protect animals that are in danger.
lines.cn: 好的动物园能保护处于危险中的动物。

lines.text: But a zoo is not the wild home where they belong.
lines.cn: 但动物园不是它们所属的野外家园。

lines.text: That's true. We must respect them, after all.
lines.cn: 确实如此。毕竟,我们必须尊重它们。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 定语从句2(关系副词 when/where/why)

units.grammarTitle: 定语从句2(关系副词 when/where/why)

reading.passage: The monarch butterfly travels thousands of kilometres south each autumn. For a long time, no one knew how it found the way, until scientists discovered that it uses the sun. Sadly, its numbers are falling fast, so people now work together to protect it.
reading.passageCn: 黑脉金斑蝶每年秋天向南迁徙数千公里。长期以来,无人知道它如何找到方向,直到科学家发现它依靠太阳。遗憾的是,它的数量正在迅速下降,因此如今人们合力保护它。

questions.q: How does the monarch butterfly find its way south?
Why do people now work together to protect it?
opts: Because its numbers are falling fast.

writing.prompt: Write a short fact file about a wild animal you like. Say what it looks like, where it lives, and why we should protect it.
writing.promptCn: 写一份你喜欢的野生动物的简短档案:它长什么样、生活在哪里、为什么我们要保护它(试着用 where/when 引导的定语从句)。

quizQuestions.q: These animals ____ south every autumn to find warmer weather.（迁徙)
The bear suddenly ____ straight back at me and did not move.（凝视)
With our help, these rare creatures have a better chance to ____.（存活)
The park is famous for the ____ of its wildlife.（多样性)
I still remember the day ____ I first saw a wild eagle.
This is the forest ____ many wild deer still feel safe.
Pollution is the reason ____ fish can no longer live in this river.
The photo ____ I took of the bear later won a prize.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 科学家发现这种昆虫靠太阳指引。
quizQuestions.audio: Scientists learned that the insect uses the sun to guide it.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 我们应该砍掉所有的树。
我们应该尊重野生动物。
quizQuestions.audio: We should always respect wild animals.

listeningQuestions.audio: Every autumn, monarch butterflies fly thousands of kilometres south.
opts: 每年秋天,黑脉金斑蝶向南飞行数千公里。

listeningQuestions.audio: The eagle uses its sharp eyes to find small animals far below.
opts: 鹰用敏锐的眼睛寻找远处下方的小动物。

listeningQuestions.audio: A good zoo can help protect animals that are in danger.
opts: 好的动物园能帮助保护濒危动物。

listeningQuestions.audio: When winter comes, many animals migrate to warmer places.
opts: 冬天来临时,许多动物迁往温暖的地方。

listeningQuestions.audio: We are only visitors to the world of wild animals.
opts: 我们只是野生动物世界里的客人。

listeningQuestions.audio: The number of these butterflies has fallen very fast.
opts: 这些蝴蝶的数量下降得很快。

finalReading.passage: When Tom joined a group that records wild birds, he could not even tell one bird from another. Instead of giving up, he went out every weekend and slowly learned to know each one by its call. A year later, he could name almost any bird in the park, and he was proud that his patience had turned a hard hobby into a real joy.

questions.q: What did Tom do instead of giving up?
options: He kept going out each weekend and learned the birds by their calls.
He stopped joining the group at once.
He bought every bird he saw.
He asked others to do the work for him.
questions.explanation: 原文 'went out every weekend and slowly learned to know each one by its call' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Tom feel a year later?
options: Tired of watching birds.
Pleased that his steady effort had been worth it.
Sorry that he had ever started.
Worried that he still knew nothing.
questions.explanation: 末句 'was proud that his patience had turned a hard hobby into a real joy'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: At One with Nature

dialogues.title: Planning a Trip to the Terraces

lines.text: Where would you like to go this holiday?
lines.cn: 这个假期你想去哪里?

lines.text: I'd love to see the Longji Rice Terraces in Guangxi.
lines.cn: 我想去看广西的龙脊梯田。

lines.text: Why there? What is special about them?
lines.cn: 为什么去那儿?它们有什么特别?

lines.text: They show how people work in harmony with nature.
lines.cn: 它们展现了人与自然如何和谐相处。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 定语从句3(介词+关系代词·非限制性定从)

units.grammarTitle: 定语从句3(介词+关系代词·非限制性定从)

reading.passage: The Longji Rice Terraces were built long ago by the local Zhuang and Yao people. Because there was little flat land, they cut the steep mountains into terraces in which they could grow rice. For hundreds of years, they have worked in harmony with nature.
reading.passageCn: 龙脊梯田很久以前由当地的壮族和瑶族人修建。因为平地很少,他们把陡峭的大山开成梯田来种水稻。几百年来,他们一直与自然和谐相处。

questions.q: Why did the people build terraces on the mountains?
opts: There was little flat land for growing rice.
They wanted to sell the mountains.
They needed a place for visitors.
They were told to by a king.

questions.q: How have the people worked for hundreds of years?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a natural wonder you like and how people live in harmony with it.
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写一写你喜欢的一处自然奇观,以及人们如何与它和谐相处。

quizQuestions.q: Because there was little flat land, the people cut the mountains into ____.
The clever farmers work in ____ with nature to grow their rice.
The mountains are steep and the ____ is too shallow for most crops.
People without a garden can ____ a small piece of land in the city.
These are the flat areas ____ the local people could grow their rice.
He is an expert ____ the Zhuang people learnt a great deal.
The reef, ____ lies off the coast of Australia, is full of life.
The terraces catch the rainwater, ____ prevents the soil from washing away.
听录音,选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 太阳把水变成水汽,水汽上升又形成云。
quizQuestions.audio: The sun turns the water into vapour, which rises and forms clouds again.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音,选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 把屋顶变成花园让城市更绿、空气更清新。
屋顶上不能种任何植物。
quizQuestions.audio: Turning rooftops into gardens makes cities greener and the air cleaner.

listeningQuestions.audio: The local people cut the steep mountains into terraces so that they could grow more rice.
opts: 当地人把陡峭的山开成梯田,以便种更多水稻。
当地人砍倒大山去卖木材。
当地人在山上建了工厂。

listeningQuestions.audio: The flat terraces hold the rainwater and stop the soil from being washed away.
opts: 平整的梯田蓄住雨水,防止土壤被冲走。

listeningQuestions.audio: The Great Barrier Reef is the largest structure on Earth made by living things.
opts: 大堡礁是地球上由生物造出的最大结构。
大堡礁是人类建造的最大桥梁。
大堡礁是地球上最小的礁石。
大堡礁完全由石头堆成。

listeningQuestions.audio: People without a garden can rent a small piece of land on which to grow things.
opts: 没有花园的人可以租一小块地来种东西。
没有花园的人只能放弃园艺。
没有花园的人必须搬去乡下。
没有花园的人只在室内种花。

listeningQuestions.audio: The knowledge is passed down through families, which means new generations keep the old methods.
opts: 这种知识在家族中代代相传,这意味着新一代沿用古老的方法。
新一代完全放弃了古法。

listeningQuestions.audio: Eating a lot of fish and meat keeps the Inuit strong in the freezing weather.
opts: 多吃鱼和肉让因纽特人在严寒中保持强壮。
因纽特人主要靠种蔬菜为生。
因纽特人生活在炎热的沙漠里。

finalReading.passage: On a small island, the local farmers once cut down many trees to sell, and soon the wind blew their thin soil away. Years later, their children planted the slopes with new trees and learned to live in harmony with the land. Today the green hills hold the rain, the crops grow well again, and visitors come to admire a place that nature and people have healed together.

questions.q: What happened after the farmers cut down many trees?
options: The wind carried away their thin soil.
The island became much richer at once.
Heavy snow covered the whole island.
More trees grew back by themselves.
questions.explanation: 原文'soon the wind blew their thin soil away'的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: Why do visitors come to the island today?
options: To buy cheap wood from the farmers.
To admire land that people and nature have healed.
To watch the trees being cut down.
To learn how to leave the island.
questions.explanation: 末句'visitors come to admire a place that nature and people have healed together'的转述(短文后半,覆盖不同位置)。

questions.q: How did the children change the island?
options: They sold even more trees than before.
They moved everyone away from the hills.
They replanted the bare slopes and cared for the land again.
They built large factories on the soil.
questions.explanation: 原文'planted the slopes with new trees and learned to live in harmony with the land'的转述。

units.title: Food for Thought

lines.text: I can't decide what to have. Any suggestions?
lines.cn: 我拿不定主意点什么,有建议吗?

lines.text: If you like spicy food, you should try the Gong Bao chicken.
lines.cn: 如果你喜欢辣的,你应该尝尝宫保鸡丁。

lines.text: Sounds great. Should we order a soup too?
lines.cn: 听起来不错。我们还要点个汤吗?

lines.text: Yes, but let's avoid the salty one and have the tomato and egg soup.
lines.cn: 好,不过别要太咸的那种,点番茄蛋汤吧。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 情态动词1(义务/建议:must/should/have to/ought to)

units.grammarTitle: 情态动词1(义务/建议:must/should/have to/ought to)

reading.passage: Growing up with a British father and a Chinese mother, I have always loved food from both cultures. My favourite treat is a cross-cultural afternoon tea: English biscuits with a cup of Chinese tea.
reading.passageCn: 在英国父亲和中国母亲的家庭里长大,我一直热爱两种文化的食物。我最喜欢的享受是一顿跨文化的下午茶:英式饼干配一杯中国茶。

questions.q: Why does the writer love food from two cultures?
opts: The writer's parents come from different cultures.
The writer disliked all home food.
The writer ran a tea shop.

questions.q: What is the writer's favourite treat?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences giving advice on healthy eating. Use one modal of advice (should / ought to) and one of obligation or prohibition (must / have to / mustn't / needn't).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话给出健康饮食的建议。用一个表建议的情态动词(should / ought to),再用一个表义务或禁止的情态动词(must / have to / mustn't / needn't)。

quizQuestions.q: The waiter ____ the fish, saying it was the chef's best dish.
Good table ____ mean you wait until everyone is served.
The steak was so ____ that it almost melted in my mouth.
My grandmother taught me a simple ____ for chicken soup.
I'm allergic to nuts, so I ____ check every label before I eat.
If you want to stay healthy, you ____ eat more fresh fruit.
These wild berries are poisonous, so you ____ eat them.
There is plenty of food, so you ____ cook anything tonight.
听句子选中文:
opts: 糖会侵蚀你的牙齿大约二十分钟。
quizQuestions.audio: The sugar in cola attacks your teeth for about twenty minutes.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 速食很方便,但新鲜食物更健康。
quizQuestions.audio: Ready meals are convenient, but fresh food is healthier.

listeningQuestions.audio: You should wait until everyone has been served before you start eating.
opts: 你应该等大家都上了菜再开始吃。
你吃完后应该马上离开。

listeningQuestions.audio: This soup is too salty, so let's add a little water.
opts: 这碗汤太咸了,我们加点水吧。

listeningQuestions.audio: You needn't try the stinky tofu if you really don't want to.
opts: 如果你实在不想吃,可以不尝臭豆腐。

listeningQuestions.audio: The chef recommended the fish, and it was truly delicious.
opts: 厨师推荐了这道鱼,确实很美味。

listeningQuestions.audio: A balanced diet should include fresh fruit and vegetables.
opts: 均衡的饮食应该包含新鲜的水果和蔬菜。
我们应该多吃油炸食物。

listeningQuestions.audio: You mustn't put metal plates in the microwave; it is dangerous.
opts: 千万不要把金属盘子放进微波炉,那很危险。
你可以用金属盘子加热食物。

finalReading.passage: At the school food festival, Mia felt nervous about tasting dishes from other countries. A classmate told her that she needn't eat anything she really disliked, but that she ought to give each dish at least a small bite. By the end of the day, Mia had found three new favourite foods and was glad that she had been brave enough to try.

questions.q: What did the classmate advise Mia to do?
options: Take a small taste of every dish, even if she wasn't sure.
Avoid all the foreign dishes completely.
Eat only the dishes she already knew.
Leave the festival before tasting anything.
questions.explanation: 同学建议每道菜至少尝一小口,即"ought to give each dish at least a small bite"的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: How did Mia feel at the end of the day?
options: Sorry that she had come to the festival.
Pleased that she had dared to try new foods.
Bored because the food was all the same.
Angry that nobody helped her choose.
questions.explanation: 末句说她很高兴自己有勇气尝试,covers 短文后半段,转述而非照抄。

units.title: Let's Celebrate!

dialogues.title: Inviting a Friend to the Lantern Festival

lines.text: Are you free this evening? It's the Lantern Festival.
lines.cn: 你今晚有空吗?今天是元宵节。

lines.text: Yes! Let's go to the lantern fair in the park.
lines.cn: 有空!我们去公园的灯会吧。

lines.text: Great. We can guess the riddles and win small prizes.
lines.cn: 好啊。我们可以猜灯谜,赢点小奖品。

lines.text: And try the sweet rice balls. Let's meet at seven.
lines.cn: 再尝尝汤圆。我们七点见吧。

dialogues.title: Guessing Who's Who at the Party

lines.text: Look, that tall guy is dressed as Batman. Is that Mike?
lines.cn: 看,那个高个子男生扮成蝙蝠侠。那是 Mike 吗?

lines.text: I'm not sure. It could be him, but I can't see his face.
lines.cn: 我不确定。可能是他,但我看不清他的脸。

lines.text: And that girl in the bride's dress — that can't be Lucy.
lines.cn: 还有那个穿婚纱的女生——那不可能是 Lucy。

lines.text: Right, Lucy isn't that tall. Let's go and find out!
lines.cn: 对,Lucy 没那么高。我们过去看看吧!

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 情态动词2(推测:must/may/might/could/can have done)

units.grammarTitle: 情态动词2(推测:must/may/might/could/can have done)

reading.passage: The Lantern Festival falls on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month. On that evening, streets glow with red lanterns, families guess riddles, and everyone enjoys sweet rice balls together.
reading.passageCn: 元宵节在农历正月十五。那天傍晚,街道被红灯笼映得通红,家家户户猜灯谜,大家一起品尝汤圆。

questions.q: When does the Lantern Festival fall?
opts: On the fifteenth day of the first lunar month.
On the last day of the year.
On the fourth Thursday in November.

questions.q: What do families do that evening?
opts: Guess riddles and eat sweet rice balls.
Race dragon boats on the river.
Stay at home and sleep early.
Watch a football game on TV.

writing.prompt: Introduce your favourite Chinese festival to a foreign friend: when it is, what people do, and what it means to you.
writing.promptCn: 向外国朋友介绍你最喜欢的中国节日:时间、人们的活动、对你的意义(试着用 fall on / decorate with 等表达)。

quizQuestions.q: The lantern fair ____ thousands of visitors every year.（吸引)
I have to ____ that cooking the dinner is hard work.（承认)
The Dragon Boat Festival is held to ____ a famous poet.（纪念)
A wedding usually needs a ____ written invitation.（正式的)
Look at the empty plates — the guests ____ the whole feast.（确定吃过了)
I'm not sure, but he ____ the invitation in his inbox.（也许没看到)
She was on a plane at noon, so she ____ at the fair then.（不可能在)
The hall is full of balloons, so someone ____ hard last night.（确定忙过)
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 午夜时分,烟花照亮了整个天空。
quizQuestions.audio: At midnight, fireworks lit up the whole sky.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 全家人在除夕之夜一起吃饭。
quizQuestions.audio: On Spring Festival Eve the whole family eats together.

listeningQuestions.audio: Families gather to celebrate the festival every year.
opts: 家家户户每年团聚庆祝这个节日。
这个节日已经被人们忘记了。
只有商店在庆祝这个节日。

listeningQuestions.audio: The children must have been very excited as they opened it.
opts: 孩子们一定不想打开它。
孩子们打开它时一定非常激动。

listeningQuestions.audio: People love to guess the riddles written on the lanterns.
opts: 人们喜欢猜写在灯笼上的谜语。

listeningQuestions.audio: Chinese people living overseas also celebrate the festival.
opts: 海外的华人不过这个节日。
居住海外的华人也庆祝这个节日。

listeningQuestions.audio: She can't have been at the lantern fair then.
opts: 她那时不可能在灯会上。

listeningQuestions.audio: The host prepared a big meal for all the guests.
opts: 主人为所有客人准备了一顿大餐。

finalReading.passage: Last year, Mei wanted to surprise her grandmother on her birthday, which happened to fall during the festival week. She quietly hung bright paper lanterns around the yard and cooked a warm bowl of sweet rice balls, her grandmother's favourite treat. When the old lady stepped outside and saw the soft glow in the evening air, she was so moved that tears came to her eyes.

questions.q: Why did Mei hang lanterns and cook rice balls?
options: She wanted to give her grandmother a birthday surprise.
She was asked to clean up the yard.
She wanted to sell them at the festival.
She was practising for a cooking competition.
questions.explanation: 短文说她想在祖母生日时给她惊喜,是对原文的转述;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: How did the grandmother feel when she saw the lanterns?
options: Bored and tired of the noise.
Deeply touched, almost to tears.
Angry about the mess in the yard.
Worried about the cost of the food.
questions.explanation: 末句说她感动得热泪盈眶,即深受触动;此处覆盖短文后半段,与首句不同位置。

units.title: On the Move

lines.text: Our school has new sports clubs. Which one will you join?
lines.cn: 我们学校有新的运动社团,你想加入哪个?

lines.text: Football, I think. It's cheap, and you only need a ball to play.
lines.cn: 我想加足球社。它便宜,只需一个球就能玩。

lines.text: I'd rather try tai chi. It's slow, but it builds balance.
lines.cn: 我更想试太极。它虽慢,却能练平衡。

lines.text: Good idea. The main thing is just to keep moving.
lines.cn: 好主意。最重要的就是动起来。

lines.text: Why do you go running every evening?
lines.cn: 你为什么每天晚上去跑步?

lines.text: To deal with the stress of a busy day. Afterwards my worries disappear.
lines.cn: 为了缓解忙碌一天的压力。跑完后烦恼就消失了。

lines.text: Isn't it hard when your legs ache?
lines.cn: 腿酸痛的时候不难受吗?

lines.text: A little, but I'm strong enough to keep going now.
lines.cn: 有点儿,但我现在已经足够强壮,能坚持下去了。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 不定式作定语和结果状语(to do)

units.grammarTitle: 不定式作定语和结果状语(to do)

reading.passage: Football began over two thousand years ago in ancient China as a game called cuju. The football we know today took shape in Britain, where it was given clear rules. It is cheap and simple to play, which is why it has become the world's favourite game.
reading.passageCn: 足球两千多年前起源于中国古代,当时叫蹴鞠。我们今天所知的足球在英国成形,并被定下了明确的规则。它便宜又简单易玩,所以成了全世界最受欢迎的运动。

questions.q: Where did modern football get its clear rules?
Why has football become the world's favourite game?
opts: It is cheap and simple to play.
It can only be played at night.
It has no rules at all.

writing.prompt: Write a short sports story about yourself. Say what sport you do, how you got started, and your goal for the future.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇关于你自己的简短运动故事:你做什么运动、当初如何开始、未来的目标(试着用上不定式,如 a sport to enjoy / strong enough to win)。

quizQuestions.q: You don't need expensive ____ to start running.(装备)
The watch can ____ your heart rate while you exercise.(监测)
After a long run, my legs ____ but I still feel happy.(酸痛)
My ____ goal is to become an ice hockey coach.(最终的)
Football is a simple game ____, which is one reason for its popularity.
He was too tired ____ the last lap, so he stopped.
The ball is small enough ____ into most sports bags.
She gets up early every day ____ for the marathon.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 他足够努力,赢得了国家队的一个席位。
他从未参加过任何比赛。
quizQuestions.audio: He trained hard enough to earn a place in the national team.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 每位跑者都穿着大猩猩服装来为野生动物筹款。
quizQuestions.audio: Every runner wears a gorilla suit to raise money for wild animals.

listeningQuestions.audio: Football is a simple game to play, and that is why it is so popular.
opts: 足球是一项简单易玩的运动,所以才如此受欢迎。
足球是一项非常昂贵的运动。

listeningQuestions.audio: She was too tired to finish the last lap of the race.
opts: 她太累了,跑不完比赛的最后一圈。
她轻松跑完了整场比赛。

listeningQuestions.audio: Tai chi involves slow movements to relax your mind and calm your body.
opts: 太极包含缓慢的动作,用来放松心情、让身体平静。
太极是一种快速的格斗运动。

listeningQuestions.audio: The sports watch is light enough to wear all day long.
opts: 这块运动手表足够轻,可以戴一整天。
这块手表太重,戴起来不舒服。
这块手表只能在网上看。

listeningQuestions.audio: He goes running every evening to deal with the stress of work.
opts: 他每天晚上跑步来缓解工作压力。

listeningQuestions.audio: With just a rope, you can skip almost anywhere and keep fit.
opts: 只要一根绳子,你几乎随处都能跳绳来保持健康。
跳绳需要一台很大的机器。
跳绳只能在体育馆里做。

finalReading.passage: Mei used to be afraid of the water, so she never thought she would learn to surf. With a patient coach and a lot of practice, she slowly learned to balance on the board, and within a year she was riding small waves on her own. Now she says that surfing has taught her to face her fears one wave at a time.

questions.q: Why didn't Mei expect to learn surfing?
options: She had always been frightened of water.
She had no coach to help her.
She disliked every kind of sport.
She lived far away from the sea.
questions.explanation: 首句说她以前怕水,所以没想过学冲浪;这是对 'afraid of the water' 的转述,其余未提或相反。

questions.q: What has surfing taught Mei?
options: To deal with her fears bit by bit.
To avoid the ocean completely.
To give up whenever it gets hard.
To win surfing competitions quickly.
questions.explanation: 末句说冲浪教她一次一个浪地面对恐惧(短文后半段),是对 'face her fears one wave at a time' 的概括转述。

units.title: Stage and Screen

lines.text: I'd like to book two tickets for the show on Saturday.
lines.cn: 我想订两张周六演出的票。

lines.text: Of course. The front seats are forty pounds each.
lines.cn: 好的。前排每张40英镑。

lines.text: That's a bit too expensive. Do you have anything cheaper?
lines.cn: 有点贵。有便宜些的吗?

lines.text: Yes, the back seats are twenty pounds, and you can still see clearly.
lines.cn: 有,后排20英镑,而且仍能看清楚。

lines.text: What would you like to watch tonight?
lines.cn: 今晚你想看什么?

lines.text: How about that new talent show everyone is talking about?
lines.cn: 看那档大家都在聊的新选秀节目怎么样?

lines.text: I'd rather watch the documentary about leopards.
lines.cn: 我更想看那部关于豹子的纪录片。

lines.text: Good idea. We can watch the talent show online later.
lines.cn: 好主意。选秀我们可以晚点在网上看。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: -ing 分词作状语(时间/原因/伴随)

units.grammarTitle: -ing 分词作状语(时间/原因/伴随)

reading.passage: I went to see a Peking Opera version of Hamlet, and I loved every minute of it. The stage was almost empty, yet a single whip stood for a horse and a screen for a whole room. Feeling the love, anger and grief in the music, I had no trouble following the story, even though it was sung in Chinese.
reading.passageCn: 我去看了一场京剧版的《哈姆雷特》,每一分钟都很享受。舞台几乎空荡,可一根鞭子就代表一匹马,一块幕布就代表整间屋子。感受到音乐中的爱、愤怒与悲痛,即使是用中文演唱,我也毫不费力地跟上了故事。

questions.q: What was the stage like?
opts: Almost empty, using simple props to suggest more.

questions.q: How could the writer follow the story?
opts: The emotions in the music made it clear.
He had memorised the whole play.

writing.prompt: Write a short review of a film or show you have seen. Say what it is about, describe one memorable scene, and tell us whether you would recommend it.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇你看过的电影或演出的短评:讲讲它的内容、描述一个难忘的场景、说说你是否推荐(试着用 -ing 分词作状语,如 Watching the film, …)。

quizQuestions.q: The talk show host was so ____ that he hardly let his guests speak.（无礼的)
As soon as the curtain rose, I was completely ____.（入迷的)
The film explores the theme of ____ in a humorous way.（责任)
I enjoy this film for its creative ____ and clever settings.（情节)
____ the curtain rise, the whole theatre fell silent at once.
Not ____ what the plot was about, the foreign guests felt a little lost.
____ by the loud applause, the actor came back on stage to bow again.
____ a bright red costume, the clown ran around the stage.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 这部电影改编自一部著名小说。
quizQuestions.audio: This film is a modern version of a classic play.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 演出开始后大门就关闭。
quizQuestions.audio: The doors close once the show begins.

listeningQuestions.audio: Peking Opera combines music, singing and acting on one stage.
opts: 京剧把音乐、演唱和表演结合在一个舞台上。
京剧只有音乐没有表演。

listeningQuestions.audio: Watching the sad ending, many viewers could not hold back their tears.
opts: 看到悲伤的结局,许多观众忍不住流泪。

listeningQuestions.audio: The film is based on a famous novel.
opts: 这部电影改编自一部著名小说。
这部电影是一部纪录片。

listeningQuestions.audio: The whole audience stood up to applaud the actors.
opts: 全场观众起立为演员鼓掌。
观众安静地离开了剧院。

listeningQuestions.audio: I'd like to book two tickets for the show on Saturday.
opts: 我想订两张周六演出的票。

listeningQuestions.audio: The nature documentary showed leopards in the wild.
opts: 这部自然纪录片展现了野外的豹子。
这是一部关于城市的喜剧。

finalReading.passage: When Daniel first joined the school drama club, he was so shy that he could hardly say a word on stage. Instead of giving up, he practised his lines every evening and slowly learned to control his nerves. By the time of the final show, he played the leading role with confidence, and the whole audience rose to applaud him.

questions.q: What was Daniel like when he first joined the club?
options: Too shy to speak much on stage.
Already a confident actor.
Angry with the other members.
Famous for his singing.
questions.explanation: 首句说他太害羞,在台上几乎说不出话,即一开始很羞怯不敢开口;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did the audience react at the final show?
options: They stood up and clapped for him.
They quietly left the theatre.
They asked him to start again.
They were disappointed by the play.
questions.explanation: 末句说全场起立为他鼓掌(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置),即观众起身鼓掌喝彩。

units.title: On the Road

lines.text: I'd like a ticket to the seaside town, please.
lines.cn: 我想买一张去海滨小镇的票。

lines.text: Of course. The next train leaving for the coast is at nine.
lines.cn: 好的。下一班开往海边的火车九点发车。

lines.text: How long is the journey?
lines.cn: 车程多长时间?

lines.text: About an hour, on a route running along the sea.
lines.cn: 大约一小时,沿着海边的一条线路行驶。

lines.text: Why don't we go hiking near the lake this weekend?
lines.cn: 这周末我们去湖边徒步怎么样?

lines.text: Good idea! The changing autumn colours there are amazing.
lines.cn: 好主意!那里变换的秋色美极了。

lines.text: Let's take the early bus. It's cheaper than driving.
lines.cn: 我们坐早班公交吧,比开车便宜。

lines.text: Great. I'll bring my camera for the setting sun.
lines.cn: 好的,我带相机去拍西沉的太阳。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: -ing 分词作定语(主动/进行含义)

units.grammarTitle: -ing 分词作定语(主动/进行含义)

reading.passage: Lauren Bath once worked as a chef, but she loved travelling more than cooking. She began posting her travel photos online, and soon thousands of people were following her blog. In the end she quit her job and became a professional travel photographer.
reading.passageCn: 劳伦·巴斯曾是一名厨师,但她爱旅行胜过爱烹饪。她开始把旅行照片发到网上,很快就有成千上万的人关注她的博客。最后她辞去工作,成了一名职业旅行摄影师。

questions.q: What did Lauren love more than cooking?
What did Lauren become in the end?

writing.prompt: Write a short postcard to a friend about a trip. Say where you are, what the scenery is like, and what you plan to do next. Try to use -ing participles such as the rising sun or a path leading to the beach.
writing.promptCn: 给朋友写一张旅行明信片:你在哪里、风景如何、接下来打算做什么。试着用 -ing 分词作定语,如 the rising sun(升起的太阳)、a path leading to the beach(通往海滩的小路)。

quizQuestions.q: Our next ____ is a quiet village in the mountains.（目的地)
Remember to ____ some foreign money before you leave.（兑换)
The ____ along the coast was beautiful and dramatic.（风景)
Adventure travellers love exploring ____ places far from cities.（偏远的)
Look at the ____ sun over the eastern hills.
The road ____ to the village is very steep and narrow.
It was the most ____ journey of my whole life.
The passengers ____ on the platform looked tired and bored.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 沿海岸行驶的巴士能看到很美的风景。
quizQuestions.audio: The bus running along the coast offers great views of the sea.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 别忘了登机前打印登机牌。
quizQuestions.audio: Don't forget to print your boarding pass before you board the plane.

listeningQuestions.audio: Our next destination is a small village by the lake.
opts: 我们的下一个目的地是湖边的小村庄。
我们的旅行已经结束了。

listeningQuestions.audio: The train follows a route running along the coast.
opts: 这趟火车沿着海岸线行驶。

listeningQuestions.audio: Remember to exchange some foreign currency before the flight.
opts: 记得在航班前兑换一些外币。

listeningQuestions.audio: The road leading to the village is steep and narrow.
opts: 通往村庄的路又陡又窄。

listeningQuestions.audio: We watched the setting sun turn the sky gold.
opts: 我们看着西沉的太阳把天空染成金色。

listeningQuestions.audio: Adventure tourists often explore remote and unusual places.
opts: 冒险游客只待在酒店里。
冒险游客常去偏远而不寻常的地方。

finalReading.passage: On the last day of their road trip, the family reached a quiet beach where no cars were allowed. They left their vehicle by the gate and walked down a narrow path leading to the sea, watching the setting sun paint the sky red. It was a tiring day, but everyone agreed it had been the most beautiful stop of the whole journey.

questions.q: How did the family get down to the sea?
options: They walked along a narrow path on foot.
They drove their vehicle onto the beach.
They took a small boat across the water.
They rode bikes down the steep hill.
questions.explanation: 原文说他们把车停在门口、沿小路步行下海('walked down a narrow path leading to the sea')的转述;车不允许进入。

questions.q: How did the family feel about this stop?
options: They thought it was the finest part of the trip.
They were sorry they had ever come.
They found it dull and wanted to leave.
They were too tired to enjoy anything.
questions.explanation: 末句说大家一致认为这是整段旅程最美的一站(短文后半,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Earth First

lines.text: What do you do to help the environment?
lines.cn: 你做些什么来保护环境?

lines.text: I ride my bike to school to reduce my carbon footprint.
lines.cn: 我骑车上学,以减少碳足迹。

lines.text: That's great. I always keep the lights off when I leave a room.
lines.cn: 很好。我离开房间时总会关灯。

lines.text: Good idea. Small habits like that really add up.
lines.cn: 好主意。这样的小习惯真的会积少成多。

lines.text: Why are so many sharks disappearing?
lines.cn: 为什么这么多鲨鱼正在消失?

lines.text: Mostly because of finning, which is very cruel.
lines.cn: 主要是因为割鳍,这非常残忍。

lines.text: That's terrible. Do sharks really attack people?
lines.cn: 太可怕了。鲨鱼真的会攻击人吗?

lines.text: Only by accident. We should protect them from extinction.
lines.cn: 只是出于意外。我们应该保护它们免于灭绝。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: -ing 与 -ed 分词作补语(宾补/主补)

units.grammarTitle: -ing 与 -ed 分词作补语(宾补/主补)

reading.passage: Every year, people throw away huge amounts of food while others go hungry. Our class joined the Clear Your Plate campaign and promised to order only what we can finish. Small choices like this can help feed more people and waste less.
reading.passageCn: 每年都有人浪费大量食物,而另一些人却在挨饿。我们班加入了'光盘行动',承诺只点自己能吃完的食物。这样的小选择能帮助养活更多人,也减少浪费。

questions.q: What did the class promise to do?
opts: To order only what they can finish.
To eat as much as possible.
To stop eating in the canteen.
To buy more food than they need.

questions.q: Why do such small choices matter?
opts: They help feed more people and waste less.

writing.prompt: Write a short note to your classmates about one thing you can do to protect the environment. Say what the problem is and what action you suggest.
writing.promptCn: 给同学们写一段话,说说你能为保护环境做的一件事:问题是什么、你建议大家怎么做(试着用分词作补语,如 keep the lights off / get rubbish recycled)。

quizQuestions.q: Many sea animals are now close to ____.(灭绝)
Making a paper bag uses a large ____ of water.(数量)
Smog can cause ____ breathing problems.(严重的)
Our class started a ____ to stop wasting food.(活动)
From the boat we saw a great white shark ____ towards us.
When the ranger arrived, he found the gate ____.
To save money, he had his old bike ____ instead of buying a new one.
Please don't leave the tap ____ while you brush your teeth.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 渔民割下鲨鱼的鳍,再把它们扔回海里。
quizQuestions.audio: Fishermen cut off the sharks' fins and threw them back into the sea.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 我们应该买更多新瓶子。
我们可以把旧瓶子拿去回收。
我们应该扔掉所有瓶子。
quizQuestions.audio: We can get our old bottles recycled at the centre.

listeningQuestions.audio: Sharks attack people only by accident.
opts: 鲨鱼伤人只是出于意外。

listeningQuestions.audio: We should reduce our carbon footprint.
Devices in stand-by mode still use electricity.
opts: 设备关掉后完全不耗电。
待机状态的设备仍在耗电。

listeningQuestions.audio: The nature reserve was established in 2000.
opts: 这个自然保护区建立于2000年。

listeningQuestions.audio: Smog can cause serious breathing problems.
opts: 雾霾会引起严重的呼吸问题。

listeningQuestions.audio: Please turn off the lights when you leave the room.
opts: 离开时请把窗户全打开。

finalReading.passage: A small island once had clear blue water and plenty of fish. After a busy factory opened nearby, waste leaked into the sea, and most of the fish soon disappeared. The villagers worked together to clean the water, and a few years later the fish slowly came back.

questions.q: What happened soon after the factory opened?
options: The island suddenly got many more fish.
The sea water became much cleaner.
Waste polluted the sea and the fish vanished.
The factory closed down at once.
questions.explanation: 原文 'waste leaked into the sea, and most of the fish soon disappeared' 的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: How did the fish finally come back?
options: The villagers cleaned the water together.
The factory gave the island new fish.
People bought fish from a faraway city.
Nothing at all was done about it.
questions.explanation: 末句 'The villagers worked together to clean the water' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Knowing Me, Knowing You

lines.text: I need to talk to you. You told everyone what I said about the match.
lines.cn: 我得跟你谈谈。你把我说的关于比赛的话告诉了所有人。

lines.text: I'm really sorry. I didn't think before I spoke, and I let you down.
lines.cn: 我真的很抱歉。我没多想就说出口了,辜负了你。

lines.text: I was only letting off steam. I never wanted the whole team to hear it.
lines.cn: 我只是在发泄情绪,根本不想让全队都听到。

lines.text: You're right. From now on, I'll keep your words to myself, I promise.
lines.cn: 你说得对。从现在起,我保证守口如瓶。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: -ed 分词作状语(原因/时间/条件)

units.grammarTitle: -ed 分词作状语(原因/时间/条件)

reading.passage: True friendship is like the porcupines on a cold night: we need each other for warmth, yet we also need a little space. Stand too close, and small differences begin to hurt; stay too far, and we feel cold and alone. The wisest friends find a comfortable distance built on honesty and trust.
reading.passageCn: 真正的友谊就像寒夜里的豪猪:我们既需要彼此取暖,也需要一点空间。靠得太近,小小的分歧便会伤人;离得太远,又会感到寒冷孤单。最明智的朋友会找到一个建立在诚实与信任之上的舒适距离。

questions.q: According to the passage, what happens if friends stand too close?
What do the wisest friends find?
opts: A comfortable distance built on trust.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about how you would deal with a small conflict with a friend. Say what happened, what you did, and how you felt. Try to use one -ed participle as an adverbial (e.g. Hurt by his words, I …).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写写你会怎样处理和朋友的一次小冲突:发生了什么、你怎么做、你的感受。试着用一个 -ed 分词作状语(如 Hurt by his words, I …)。

quizQuestions.q: Speaking too freely can cause all kinds of ____ between friends.
Trust is the ____ value of any close friendship.
A true friend gives you ____ comments so that you can improve.
First, you should ____ to your teammate for your careless words.
____ by his behaviour, I told my best friend everything.
____ more time, most people will do a better job.
____ about her sick friend, Anna could not focus on her homework.
____ in this way, your friendship will soon be repaired.
听句子选中文:
opts: 他被当众批评,感到很尴尬。
我们一个接一个地自我介绍。
quizQuestions.audio: Criticised in front of others, he felt very embarrassed.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 被好友的支持打动,她内心感到温暖。
quizQuestions.audio: Touched by her friend's support, she felt warm inside.

listeningQuestions.audio: Disappointed by his behaviour, I told my best friend everything.
opts: 对他的行为感到失望,我把一切都告诉了好友。

listeningQuestions.audio: I was only letting off steam when I complained about my teammate.
opts: 我抱怨队友时只是在发泄情绪。

listeningQuestions.audio: A sincere apology can repair a damaged friendship.
opts: 真诚的道歉能修复受损的友谊。

listeningQuestions.audio: Good friendships, like the porcupines, need a little space.
opts: 好的友谊就像豪猪一样,需要一点空间。

listeningQuestions.audio: Take a deep breath and calm down before you speak in anger.
opts: 生气说话前,先深吸一口气冷静下来。
他把秘密告诉了所有人。

listeningQuestions.audio: Honesty is the core of every true friendship.
opts: 诚实是每段真挚友谊的核心。

finalReading.passage: When Daniel noticed that his friend Omar looked unusually quiet at lunch, he did not just walk away. Instead, he sat down, asked gently what was wrong, and listened without judging. Comforted by Daniel's patience, Omar finally shared his worry, and the heavy feeling inside him began to lift.

questions.q: What did Daniel do when he saw Omar looking quiet?
options: He sat down and gently asked what was wrong.
He walked away and said nothing.
He laughed at Omar in front of others.
He told everyone about Omar's mood.
questions.explanation: 原文 'he sat down, asked gently what was wrong, and listened' 的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: How did Omar feel by the end of the lunch?
options: Angry that Daniel had asked him.
Relieved after sharing his worry.
Sorry that he had come to school.
Bored by the whole conversation.
questions.explanation: 末句 'the heavy feeling inside him began to lift' 说明他卸下负担、感到轻松,这是对短文后半段的转述。

units.title: Making a Difference

lines.text: I'm joining a charity run for the children's hospital. Would you like to come?
lines.cn: 我要参加一个为儿童医院举办的慈善跑,你想来吗?

lines.text: I'd love to! How does the run raise money?
lines.cn: 我很乐意!这个跑步怎么筹钱呢?

lines.text: Friends donate some money for every runner who finishes.
lines.cn: 亲友为每位完赛的人捐一些钱。

lines.text: Great idea. Let's train together this week.
lines.cn: 好主意,我们这周一起训练吧。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: -ed 分词作定语(被动/完成含义)

units.grammarTitle: -ed 分词作定语(被动/完成含义)

reading.passage: Sam visited his lonely neighbours every weekend and listened to their stories. Soon the whole street felt warmer, and he saw that one caring person can change a community.
reading.passageCn: 萨姆每个周末都去看望孤独的邻居,听他们讲故事。不久整条街都变得更温暖,他明白了一个有爱心的人可以改变一个社区。

questions.q: What did Sam do every weekend?
opts: He stayed in bed all day.

questions.q: What did Sam come to understand?
opts: One caring person can change a community.

writing.prompt: Write about a person who has made a difference. Mention one key action and one personal quality.
writing.promptCn: 写一写一位'有所作为'的人,提到他/她的一件关键事迹和一种个人品质。

quizQuestions.q: 选出与'捐赠;捐献'意思相符的词
选出与'短缺;不足'意思相符的词
选出与'慷慨的;大方的'意思相符的词
选出与'成就;成绩'意思相符的词
Ryan could hardly believe the words ____ by his teacher.
The children drank from a newly ____ well.
The money ____ by his foundation supports many villages.
The ____ children were too afraid to look at the soldiers.
听句子选中文意思
opts: 她填好登记表去做志愿者。
quizQuestions.audio: She filled in a registration form to become a volunteer.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文意思
opts: 这家慈善商店由志愿者经营。
这家商店在火车站旁边。
quizQuestions.audio: The charity shop is run by volunteers.

listeningQuestions.audio: Ryan raised enough money to build a well in Africa.
opts: 瑞安筹够了钱在非洲建一口井。
瑞安买了一张去非洲的机票。
瑞安在非洲找到了一份工作。
瑞安在非洲丢了他的钱。

listeningQuestions.audio: Many kind people donate money to charity every year.
opts: 许多好心人每年向慈善机构捐钱。
许多孩子每年都换学校。

listeningQuestions.audio: The grateful children invited him to visit their school.
opts: 心怀感激的孩子们邀请他来参观学校。
生气的孩子们让他离开。
孩子们忘记了他的名字。
孩子们卖掉了他们的书。

listeningQuestions.audio: Volunteers give their free time to help other people.
opts: 志愿者付出空闲时间帮助他人。
志愿者只在有报酬时工作。

listeningQuestions.audio: Tu Youyou found a new treatment for malaria.
opts: 屠呦呦找到了治疗疟疾的新方法。
屠呦呦建了一所新医院。

listeningQuestions.audio: Even a small action can make a real difference.
opts: 即使微小的行动也能带来真正的改变。
只有大人物才能帮助世界。
金钱是帮助别人的唯一方式。
帮助别人是在浪费时间。

finalReading.passage: Last year, a quiet boy named Sam noticed that the old people on his street were often lonely. Every weekend he began to visit them, bringing small gifts and listening patiently to their stories. Soon the whole street felt warmer, and Sam learned that one caring person can truly change a community.

questions.q: What problem did Sam notice on his street?
options: Many elderly neighbours were feeling lonely.
There was far too much traffic outside.
The old people had nothing to eat.
The children were doing badly at school.
questions.explanation: 原文说街上的老人常感到孤独,此为转述;其余三项原文未提或与原文相反。

questions.q: What did Sam learn from helping his neighbours?
options: Helping others always wastes a lot of time.
Even one kind person can improve a community.
Only money can make old people happy.
Lonely people can never be helped at all.
questions.explanation: 末句'one caring person can truly change a community'的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: The World of Science

lines.text: Which modern invention do you think is the most amazing?
lines.cn: 你觉得哪项现代发明最了不起?

lines.text: The 3D printer. New body parts have already been made with it.
lines.cn: 3D打印机。人们已经用它制造出新的身体部件了。

lines.text: Really? So it has been used in medicine too?
lines.cn: 真的吗?那它也被用在医学上了?

lines.text: Yes. Hearts and bones have been printed to help patients.
lines.cn: 是的。心脏和骨头已被打印出来帮助病人。

lines.text: What kind of scientist would you like to be?
lines.cn: 你想成为哪种科学家?

lines.text: An astronomer. I love studying the stars and planets.
lines.cn: 天文学家。我热爱研究恒星和行星。

lines.text: But isn't the maths very hard?
lines.cn: 可是数学不是很难吗?

lines.text: A little, but with patience every subject can be learned.
lines.cn: 有点儿,但只要有耐心,任何科目都能学会。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 现在完成被动语态(have/has been done)

units.grammarTitle: 现在完成被动语态(have/has been done)

reading.passage: Many people think the great age of invention is over, but it has only just begun. Today most new inventions are based on technology, and important progress has been made in medicine and the environment. As long as people keep asking questions, fresh ideas will always appear.
reading.passageCn: 许多人以为伟大的发明时代已经结束,但其实它才刚刚开始。如今大多数新发明都以技术为基础,医学和环境领域也取得了重要进展。只要人们不停发问,新点子就会不断涌现。

questions.q: What are most new inventions based on today?
What keeps fresh ideas appearing?

writing.prompt: Write a few sentences about an invention you find amazing. Say what it is, what it has been used for, and why it matters. Try to use the present perfect passive (e.g. has been used / have been made).
writing.promptCn: 写几句话介绍一个你觉得了不起的发明:它是什么、被用来做什么、为什么重要。试着用上现在完成被动语态(如 has been used / have been made)。

quizQuestions.q: Sailors used a ____ to find their way far out at sea.(指南针)
A ____ studies the stars and planets in space.(天文学家)
There is still no ____ for this serious disease.(疗法)
The new battery is thin and ____, so it can bend easily.(柔韧的)
So far, many great inventions ____ by ordinary people.
Up to now, no time machine ____ anywhere in the world.
Recently, this technology ____ many human body parts.
Over the past ten years, many electric cars ____ in this city.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 近年来,太阳能技术取得了重大进步。
太阳能只能在白天使用。
太阳能技术已经被放弃。
quizQuestions.audio: In recent years, significant advances have been made in solar technology.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 这个团队的研究成果已发表在一本著名杂志上。
团队从未做过任何研究。
杂志拒绝刊登他们的成果。
quizQuestions.audio: The team's results have been published in a famous magazine.

listeningQuestions.audio: Many useful inventions have been made in recent years.
opts: 近年来人们发明了许多有用的东西。
近年来再也没有新发明了。
古代的发明比现代的好。

listeningQuestions.audio: New 3D printers have been used to make replacement body parts.
opts: 新型3D打印机已被用来制造替换的身体部件。

listeningQuestions.audio: The intelligent walking house is powered by the sun, so it is eco-friendly.
opts: 这座智能行走房屋靠太阳能驱动,所以很环保。
这座房子要烧煤才能移动。
这座房子从来不会移动。

listeningQuestions.audio: So far, no time machine has been invented anywhere in the world.
opts: 到目前为止,世界上任何地方都还没发明出时间机器。
时间机器去年已经造好了。
时间机器是中国人发明的。

listeningQuestions.audio: A turtle injured in a fire was given a new 3D-printed shell.
opts: 一只在火灾中受伤的乌龟得到了一个3D打印的新壳。
那只乌龟一直没被找到。

listeningQuestions.audio: Most inventions begin when someone notices a problem that needs a solution.
opts: 大多数发明始于有人发现了需要解决的问题。
发明从来不需要任何问题。
只有政府才能发明东西。

finalReading.passage: Last year, a teenage girl built a simple alarm to help her deaf grandfather. When the doorbell rings, a bright light has been set to flash across every room. The quiet invention has already made the old man feel much safer at home.

questions.q: Why did the girl build the alarm?
options: To help her grandfather who cannot hear.
To win a prize at her school.
To sell it to the neighbours.
To wake people up in the morning.
questions.explanation: 原文'to help her deaf grandfather'的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What happens when the doorbell rings?
options: The door locks itself.
A bright light flashes in the rooms.
A bell rings outside the house.
All the lights go off.
questions.explanation: 原文'a bright light has been set to flash across every room'的转述(短文中段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Amazing Art

lines.text: Which work in this exhibition do you like most?
lines.cn: 这个展览里你最喜欢哪件作品?

lines.text: The stone horse. Look — it is being protected by glass right now.
lines.cn: 那匹石马。看,它此刻正被玻璃罩保护着。

lines.text: Why do you like it so much?
lines.cn: 你为什么这么喜欢它?

lines.text: Because the sculptor caught the animal's wild spirit so well.
lines.cn: 因为雕塑家把这匹马狂野的神韵抓得太好了。

lines.text: Do you think art is only found in museums?
lines.cn: 你觉得艺术只能在博物馆里找到吗?

lines.text: No, art is everywhere. Look at the pictures being painted on that wall.
lines.cn: 不,艺术无处不在。看那面墙上正在画的画。

lines.text: You're right. Even the trees are being trimmed into lovely shapes.
lines.cn: 你说得对。连树也正被修剪成漂亮的形状。

lines.text: Exactly. Great art can be found in our own neighbourhood.
lines.cn: 正是。伟大的艺术就在我们自己的社区里。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 现在进行被动语态(is/are being done)

units.grammarTitle: 现在进行被动语态(is/are being done)

reading.passage: In a small studio by the river, an old sculptor is making a stone horse. At the moment, its legs are being carved with great care, and bits of stone cover the floor. Many visitors come to watch, sure that the finished horse will look ready to gallop away.
reading.passageCn: 在河边一间小工作室里,一位老雕塑家正在做一匹石马。此刻马腿正被精心雕琢,石屑铺满地面。许多人前来观看,坚信完成后的马看起来仿佛要飞奔而去。

questions.q: What is the sculptor doing at the moment?
opts: Carving the legs of a stone horse.
Painting a picture of a horse.

questions.q: What do the visitors believe about the finished horse?
opts: It will look ready to run away.
It will be too small to see.
It will soon be sold abroad.

writing.prompt: Write a short article about an artwork you like. Say what it is, who made it, and how you feel about it. Try to use 'is/are being displayed'.
writing.promptCn: 写一段你喜欢的艺术作品介绍:是什么、谁创作的、你的感受(试着用 is/are being displayed)。

quizQuestions.q: The skill of the ____ who made this statue is amazing.（雕塑家)
We saw a breathtaking ____ of Chinese porcelain at the festival.（展览)
His calligraphy looks so free and ____.（优雅的)
The Tang emperors were very ____ of horses.（喜爱:be ___ of)
Look — a new exhibition ____ in the main hall right now.
At the moment, several old vases ____ to a safer room.
Right now, a famous self-portrait ____ next to the old masters.
Listen — the story of the painting ____ to the children now.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 开门前博物馆的地面正在被清扫。
quizQuestions.audio: The museum floor is being swept before the doors open.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 这位年轻艺术家正把自己的名字刻进石头。
quizQuestions.audio: The young artist is carving his name into the stone.

listeningQuestions.audio: The painting is being cleaned by two experts right now.
opts: 这幅画此刻正被两位专家清洗。
两位专家在画一幅新画。

listeningQuestions.audio: Get a load of that magnificent sculpture over there!
opts: 快看那边那座宏伟的雕塑!

listeningQuestions.audio: Chinese calligraphy is written with a soft brush and black ink.
opts: 中国书法是用软笔和黑墨书写的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Many young artists are painting colourful pictures on the old wall.
opts: 许多年轻艺术家正在旧墙上画彩色的画。
工人正在拆掉这面旧墙。

listeningQuestions.audio: The blue-and-white vase is being moved to a safer room.
opts: 那只青花瓶正被搬到更安全的房间。

listeningQuestions.audio: Han Gan learned to paint horses by watching real ones.
opts: 韩干通过观察真马学会了画马。

finalReading.passage: In many old towns of China, a few skilled workers still make porcelain entirely by hand. Right now, in one small workshop, blue dragons are being painted onto white bowls, while finished pieces are being carried gently to a hot oven. Visitors from all over the world come to watch, amazed that such patient work still survives today.

questions.q: What are the workers in the workshop doing right now?
options: Decorating bowls and getting them ready for the oven.
Selling finished bowls to foreign tourists.
Cleaning the floor of the empty workshop.
Teaching the visitors how to paint at home.
questions.explanation: 原文说蓝龙正被画到白碗上、做好的瓷器被送进热炉,即装饰碗并准备烧制;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: Why are the visitors amazed?
options: Because the bowls are made quickly by machines.
Because such careful handwork has lasted to this day.
Because the bowls are painted only in red.
Because the workshop is the largest in the world.
questions.explanation: 末句说游客惊讶于这种耐心的手工活至今仍存,即如此细致的手工保留至今。

units.title: What an Adventure!

lines.text: Where shall we go for our next adventure?
lines.cn: 我们下次冒险去哪儿?

lines.text: I was going to suggest hiking in the mountains.
lines.cn: 我本想提议去山里徒步。

lines.text: Good idea. The guide said the weather would be fine this weekend.
lines.cn: 好主意。向导说这周末天气会不错。

lines.text: Then let's pack a first aid kit, just in case.
lines.cn: 那我们带个急救包,以防万一。

lines.text: How was your climb up the mountain?
lines.cn: 你登山怎么样?

lines.text: Scary! I knew it would be hard, but the storm surprised us.
lines.cn: 惊险!我知道会很难,但那场风暴让我们措手不及。

lines.text: Did you reach the top?
lines.cn: 你们登顶了吗?

lines.text: Not this time, but I felt proud that we got down safely.
lines.cn: 这次没有,但我们安全下山,我感到自豪。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 过去将来时(would do / was going to do)

units.grammarTitle: 过去将来时(would do / was going to do)

reading.passage: Each year, hundreds of climbers pay good money to climb Qomolangma, even though they know the trip will bring cold, crowds and danger. Many feel weak in the death zone, where there is very little oxygen. Yet most believe that reaching the top is worth every risk.
reading.passageCn: 每年都有数百名登山者花重金攀登珠峰,尽管他们知道这趟旅程会有寒冷、人群和危险。许多人在缺氧的死亡地带感到虚弱。然而大多数人相信,登顶值得冒一切风险。

questions.q: Why do climbers still pay to climb the mountain?
opts: They believe reaching the top is worth the risk.
They think the climb is cheap and safe.
They want to live in the death zone.
They dislike the views at the top.

questions.q: What is the death zone like?
opts: It is warm and crowded with shops.
It is the safest part of the climb.
It lies at the foot of the mountain.

writing.prompt: Write a short story about an adventure you have had or imagined. Say when and where it happened, what happened, and how you felt. Try to use the past future (I knew it would…, We were going to…).
writing.promptCn: 写一个你经历或想象的冒险小故事:何时何地发生、发生了什么、你的感受。试着用过去将来时(I knew it would…, We were going to…)。

quizQuestions.q: Above 8,000 metres lies the death ____, with very little oxygen.（地带）
Most ____ to climb the peak end in success or failure.（尝试）
Words were not enough to ____ the wonders he had seen.（讲述）
A whole new world lay ____ the surface of the sea.（在……之下）
Mallory promised that he ____ home safely.
I ____ to collect water, but the storm broke our barrels.
She said she ____ join the next expedition to the South Pole.
We knew that the journey ahead ____ both body and mind.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 他知道那次旅程会很艰难。
quizQuestions.audio: He knew the journey would be very hard.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 他们本打算横渡海峡，但风暴来了。
quizQuestions.audio: They were going to cross the strait, but a storm came.

listeningQuestions.audio: The captain said the ship would leave port at dawn.
opts: 船长说船将在黎明驶离港口。

listeningQuestions.audio: I was going to climb higher, but a storm stopped me.
opts: 我本打算爬得更高,但风暴让我停下了。

listeningQuestions.audio: Qomolangma lies on the border between Nepal and China.
opts: 珠峰离任何国家都很远。
珠峰位于尼泊尔和中国的边界上。

listeningQuestions.audio: Above eight thousand metres there is very little oxygen.
We learned some first aid before the trip.
opts: 出发前我们学了一些急救。

listeningQuestions.audio: The young seals were curious and followed the divers.
opts: 小海豹好奇地跟着潜水者。

finalReading.passage: Before the team set off across the frozen land, the leader warned them that the journey would be the hardest of their lives. They had planned to cross the ice in twenty days, but a fierce storm slowed them down. In the end, tired but proud, they reached the far shore three weeks later than expected.

questions.q: What did the leader say about the journey?
options: It would be the toughest one they had ever made.
It would be short and easy.
It would be cancelled at once.
It would need no planning at all.
questions.explanation: 原文 'the journey would be the hardest of their lives' 的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: Why did the team arrive later than planned?
options: Because they started far too late.
Because a strong storm held them back.
Because they lost all their maps.
Because they stopped to rest for fun.
questions.explanation: 原文 'a fierce storm slowed them down' 的转述(短文中段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Disaster and Hope

lines.text: The forecast says a typhoon will arrive tonight. Are we ready?
lines.cn: 预报说台风今晚到。我们准备好了吗?

lines.text: Almost. Remember to fill some bottles with clean water.
lines.cn: 差不多了。记得灌几瓶干净的水。

lines.text: Good idea. Should we go outside to watch it?
lines.cn: 好主意。我们要出去看台风吗?

lines.text: Never! We must stay indoors until the warning is over.
lines.cn: 千万不要!我们必须待在室内,直到警报解除。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 省略(Ellipsis:状语从句/对话/并列结构中的省略)

units.grammarTitle: 省略(Ellipsis:状语从句/对话/并列结构中的省略)

reading.passage: When the wildfire reached the edge of the town, hundreds of families had to leave their homes in a single night. Firefighters worked for days without rest, and people from nearby towns sent food, water and warm clothes. Though much was lost, no lives were taken, and the town soon began to rebuild, stronger and closer than before.
reading.passageCn: 当山火逼近镇子边缘时,数百个家庭不得不在一夜之间离开家园。消防员连日不眠地奋战,附近城镇的人们送来食物、水和保暖衣物。尽管损失惨重,却无人丧生,小镇很快开始重建,比从前更坚强、更团结。

questions.q: Why did the families have to leave their homes?
opts: A wildfire reached the edge of the town.

questions.q: How did people from nearby towns help?
opts: They put out the fire by themselves.
They sent food, water and warm clothes.
They took away the town's land.

questions.q: What happened to the town in the end?
opts: It began to rebuild, stronger and closer.
It was hit by a second fire.

writing.prompt: In about 60 words, write two short tips telling people what to do when a typhoon is coming. Use 'Remember to…' and 'Never…'.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写两条小贴士,告诉人们台风来临时该做什么。用上 'Remember to…' 和 'Never…'。

quizQuestions.q: (灾难、事故)'夺去(生命)'用哪个动词?
提前'预测、预报'天气用哪个词?
困住村庄的'暴风雪'对应的英文是?
为受灾者'捐钱捐物','捐赠'用哪个词?
When ____ about the coming storm, the villagers left at once.（他们被警告)
He survived the flood, and so ____ his dog.
While ____ for the rescue boat, we kept calm.
—Would you like to join the rescue team? —Yes, I'd love ____.
听句子选中文:
opts: 警报响时,立刻转移到高处。
quizQuestions.audio: Move to high ground immediately when the warning sounds.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 一点小小的准备就能挽救许多生命。
quizQuestions.audio: A little preparation can save many lives.

listeningQuestions.audio: A strong typhoon is expected to hit the coast tonight.
opts: 一场强台风预计今晚袭击海岸。

listeningQuestions.audio: The rescue team pulled three people out of the ruins.
opts: 救援队从废墟中救出了三个人。

listeningQuestions.audio: Remember to store enough food and water before a flood.
opts: 洪水来临前要备足食物和水。

listeningQuestions.audio: Satellites help scientists forecast storms more precisely.
opts: 卫星帮助科学家更精确地预报风暴。

listeningQuestions.audio: Many kind strangers donated money to help the survivors.
opts: 许多好心的陌生人捐钱帮助幸存者。
幸存者把钱捐给了陌生人。
陌生人借走了幸存者的钱。

listeningQuestions.audio: Even after the disaster, the town slowly came back to life.
opts: 灾难让小镇永远消失了。
灾难过后,小镇慢慢恢复了生机。

finalReading.passage: After the flood washed away their farm, the Wang family had almost nothing left. Instead of losing heart, they planted new rice the moment the water went down, and neighbours arrived each morning to lend a hand. By autumn, green fields covered the land again, and the family understood that hope grows fastest when people stand together.

questions.q: What did the Wang family do instead of losing heart?
options: They began planting rice again as soon as the water fell.
They sold their land and left the village.
They waited a whole year before doing anything.
They blamed their neighbours for the flood.
questions.explanation: 原文 'planted new rice the moment the water went down' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did the neighbours help the family?
options: They turned up every morning to give a hand.
They sent money from a faraway city.
They took the family to a shelter.
They did nothing at all.
questions.explanation: 原文 'neighbours arrived each morning to lend a hand' 的转述措辞,非连续照抄。

questions.q: What did the family finally understand?
options: That farming is a waste of effort.
That floods can never be survived.
That working together brings hope back quickly.
That they should move far away.
questions.explanation: 末句 'hope grows fastest when people stand together' 的转述,覆盖短文结尾。

units.title: Laugh Out Loud!

lines.text: Have you seen any good comedies lately?
lines.cn: 你最近看过什么好喜剧吗?

lines.text: Yes, I watched 'My Crazy Family', which made me laugh out loud.
lines.cn: 看了,我看了《我的疯狂家庭》,让我笑出了声。

lines.text: Who is in it?
lines.cn: 谁主演的?

lines.text: A comedian called Tom Lee, whose timing is just perfect. You should watch it tonight!
lines.cn: 一位叫 Tom Lee 的笑星,他的节奏感堪称完美。你今晚该看看!

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 非限制性定语从句(which/who/whose · 介词+which)

units.grammarTitle: 非限制性定语从句(which/who/whose · 介词+which)

reading.passage: People say that laughter is the best medicine, and science agrees. A good laugh helps the body make chemicals that ease worry, which is why clown doctors are so welcome in hospitals. A joke cannot heal a broken bone, but it can make a hard day feel a little easier.
reading.passageCn: 人们说笑是最好的良药,科学也同意。开怀大笑能帮身体产生缓解烦恼的化学物质,这正是小丑医生在医院如此受欢迎的原因。笑话治不好骨折,但它能让艰难的一天好过一点。

questions.q: Why are clown doctors welcome in hospitals?
opts: Laughter helps the body ease worry.

questions.q: What does the passage admit a joke cannot do?
opts: Heal a broken bone by itself.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences introducing a comedian or a funny person who makes you laugh. Say who they are, why they are funny, and how you feel. Try to use one non-defining clause, e.g. '…, who …' or '…, which …'.
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍一位让你发笑的喜剧演员或有趣的人:他/她是谁、为什么好笑、你的感受。试着用一个非限制性定语从句,如 '…, who …' 或 '…, which …'。

quizQuestions.q: A funny joke usually ____ when a child feels sad and will not smile.
The clown put on a curly rainbow ____ before walking into the ward.
Lin's audience ____ with laughter at his clever little joke.
On April Fool's Day, people love to play a ____ on each other.
Mark Twain, ____ was an American writer, was famous for his quick wit.
The little girl, ____ ankle was badly hurt, soon began to smile again.
He produced her sock from his pocket, ____ made the little girl laugh.
The clown doctors, many of ____ trained as actors, also learn medical skills.
听句子选中文:
opts: 小丑医生和真正的医生护士一起工作。
quizQuestions.audio: Clown doctors always work together with the real doctors and nurses.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 看喜剧时别喝东西,否则会笑得洒出来。
quizQuestions.audio: Don't drink anything while you watch the comedy, or you'll spill it laughing.

listeningQuestions.audio: A clown doctor wears a bright wig and a big red nose to make sick children smile.
opts: 小丑医生戴鲜艳假发和大红鼻子,逗患病的孩子笑。
医生今天忘了带听诊器。

listeningQuestions.audio: Mark Twain was famous for his witty replies in everyday life.
opts: 马克·吐温因日常生活中机智的回答而出名。

listeningQuestions.audio: On April Fool's Day, people in many countries play tricks on one another.
opts: 愚人节那天大家都要上学。
愚人节是一个安静的节日。
愚人节那天许多国家的人互相搞恶作剧。

listeningQuestions.audio: Studies show that laughter helps the body make chemicals that lower stress.
opts: 研究说笑没有任何作用。
研究表明笑能帮身体产生降低压力的化学物质。

listeningQuestions.audio: Charlie Chaplin could make people laugh without saying a single word.
opts: 查理·卓别林不用说一个字就能逗人发笑。
卓别林写了很多严肃的小说。

listeningQuestions.audio: Lin Yutang told a short joke, which made the whole audience roar with laughter.
opts: 林语堂讲课从不用笑话。
林语堂讲了个短笑话,逗得全场哄堂大笑。
林语堂忘了自己要讲什么。

finalReading.passage: When Tom forgot his lines during the school play, he did not panic. Instead, he made a funny face and pretended to trip over, which turned his mistake into the biggest laugh of the night. The audience clapped so hard that Tom began to wonder whether he might enjoy being a comedian after all.

questions.q: What did Tom do after he forgot his lines?
options: He turned the moment into a joke.
He ran off the stage in tears.
He blamed the other actors.
He stopped the whole play.
questions.explanation: 原文 'made a funny face and pretended to trip over... biggest laugh of the night' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did the evening change the way Tom saw himself?
options: He decided never to act again.
He felt ashamed of his mistake.
He thought he might like being a comedian.
He grew afraid of large audiences.
questions.explanation: 末句 'began to wonder whether he might enjoy being a comedian'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Onwards and Upwards

lines.text: I keep failing this part of the piano piece. Maybe I should quit.
lines.cn: 钢琴这一段我老是弹不好,也许我该放弃。

lines.text: Don't give up. Success rarely happens overnight.
lines.cn: 别放弃。成功很少一蹴而就。

lines.text: You're right. I'll decide to practise a little every evening.
lines.cn: 你说得对。我决定每晚练一会儿。

lines.text: That's the spirit. Keep trying, and your work will pay off.
lines.cn: 这就对了。坚持下去,你的努力会有回报。

lines.text: I ran for class leader, but I wasn't elected. I feel terrible.
lines.cn: 我竞选班长却落选了,心里很难受。

lines.text: I'm sorry, but try looking on the bright side. You did your best.
lines.cn: 我很遗憾,但试着往好处看吧。你已尽力了。

lines.text: I suppose one result can't decide everything.
lines.cn: 我想,一次结果决定不了一切。

lines.text: Exactly. Stop worrying and be proud of how hard you worked.
lines.cn: 正是。别再担心了,为自己的努力感到自豪吧。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: -ing 与不定式作宾语(动词后接 doing / to do 的辨析)

units.grammarTitle: -ing 与不定式作宾语(动词后接 doing / to do 的辨析)

reading.passage: Many famous writers did not become successful at once. Before her books sold millions of copies, J.K. Rowling faced twelve rejections, yet she refused to give up. Her story reminds us that perseverance, not luck, is the real key to success.
reading.passageCn: 许多著名作家并非一举成名。在书卖出数百万册之前,J.K. 罗琳遭遇了十二次拒绝,却不肯放弃。她的故事提醒我们:坚持,而非运气,才是成功真正的钥匙。

questions.q: How many rejections did Rowling face before her success?
What does her story say is the real key to success?

writing.prompt: Write a short passage (about 60 words) about a time you kept going and overcame a challenge. Use at least one 'doing' object and one 'to do' object (e.g. enjoy doing, decide to do).
writing.promptCn: 写一篇约60词的短文,讲一次你坚持下来、克服困难的经历。至少用一个 doing 宾语和一个 to do 宾语(如 enjoy doing、decide to do)。

quizQuestions.q: These are the words that every writer ____ receiving: "We regret to inform you..."
After twelve refusals, she still refused to give up; her ____ finally paid off.
Talent alone cannot ____ success; hard work matters just as much.
A person who always spoils the fun is called a wet ____.
Even now, Liu Wei still enjoys ____ music to his fans.
After many rejections, she decided ____ writing in her own way.
I still remember ____ my first rejection letter years ago.
