quizQuestions.q: At eighteen, you finally reach the ____, the age of majority.
I don't have a ____ income yet, so a credit card could be risky.
Growing up taught me that ____ means doing right even when no one watches.
The change has been more ____ and gradual than I had imagined.
Don't call me at eight tonight — I ____ dinner with my family then.
While you are lying on the beach next week, I ____ for my final exams.
I promise I ____ the household bills as soon as I get my first wage.
"____ the car tomorrow, Dad? I'd like to drive to the library."
听句子选中文:
opts: 从前我自私,如今我学着替别人着想。
quizQuestions.audio: Instead of being the selfish teenager I used to be, I now think of others.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 我明天反正要去图书馆,顺便帮你还书。
quizQuestions.audio: I will be going to the library tomorrow anyway, so I can return your books.

listeningQuestions.audio: In most countries, turning eighteen marks the start of adulthood.
opts: 在大多数国家,年满18岁标志着成年的开始。
在大多数国家,孩子十岁就要工作。
成年从来没有固定的年龄。

listeningQuestions.audio: This time tomorrow, I will be taking my driving test.
opts: 明天的这个时候,我正在考驾照。
我昨天已经考过驾照了。

listeningQuestions.audio: He took out a bank loan to pay the deposit on his first apartment.
opts: 他申请银行贷款来支付第一套公寓的押金。

listeningQuestions.audio: Real maturity is also about the small, everyday choices you make.
opts: 真正的成熟只关乎年龄。
成熟意味着不再做任何决定。
真正的成熟也在于你每天做出的小选择。

listeningQuestions.audio: Will you be using the computer this evening? If not, may I borrow it?
opts: 今晚你会用电脑吗?如果不用,我能借吗?

listeningQuestions.audio: Whatever our choices are, we should cherish these moments in life.
opts: 无论我们做什么选择,都应珍惜生命中的这些时刻。
我们应该尽快忘掉这些时刻。
只有快乐的时刻才值得记住。

finalReading.passage: On her eighteenth birthday, Zoe expected to feel completely different, but the morning felt just like any other. Over the following months, however, she slowly began to think more about others and to take charge of her own choices. By the end of the year, she realised that becoming an adult had been a quiet, gradual journey rather than a single magic moment.

questions.q: How did Zoe feel on the morning of her birthday?
options: Much the same as on any ordinary day.
Suddenly like a totally new person.
Frightened of all her new duties.
Sad that her childhood was gone.
questions.explanation: 原文说那天早上和平常没什么两样,为其转述;其余与原文不符或未提。

questions.q: What did Zoe realise by the end of the year?
options: That adulthood arrives in one magic moment.
That growing up had been a slow, gradual process.
That nothing about her had changed at all.
That she would never feel like an adult.
questions.explanation: 末句说成年是安静、逐渐的过程而非某个神奇瞬间,为其转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Improving Yourself

lines.text: I waste hours on my phone every night. I want to change that.
lines.cn: 我每晚都在手机上浪费好几个小时，我想改改。

lines.text: Why not switch it off and leave it in another room while you study?
lines.cn: 学习时为什么不把它关掉、放到另一个房间呢？

lines.text: Good idea. The first days will be hard, though.
lines.cn: 好主意。不过头几天会很难。

lines.text: Step by step it gets easier. Soon the habit will be broken.
lines.cn: 一步一步会越来越容易，很快这个习惯就被改掉了。

lines.text: I never manage to save any of my pocket money.
lines.cn: 我从来存不下一点零花钱。

lines.text: Try putting a little into a jar before you spend the rest.
lines.cn: 试试先往罐子里放一点，再花剩下的。

lines.text: Watching it grow might give me a clear goal.
lines.cn: 看着它变多也许会给我一个清晰的目标。

lines.text: Exactly. By the end of the year you'll be surprised how much has been saved.
lines.cn: 没错。到年底你会惊讶于已经存下了这么多。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 过去完成被动语态(had been done)

units.grammarTitle: 过去完成被动语态(had been done)

reading.passage: Mia set herself one small goal: to read ten English pages every night before bed. After two months, the habit had been firmly built, and reading no longer felt like hard work to her.
reading.passageCn: Mia 给自己定了一个小目标：每晚睡前读十页英语。两个月后，这个习惯已经牢牢养成，读书对她来说不再是苦差事。

questions.q: What was Mia's small goal?
opts: To read ten pages of English each night.
To sleep ten hours a night.
To write ten letters a week.

questions.q: How did Mia feel about reading after two months?
opts: It no longer felt like hard work.

writing.prompt: Write a short reflection about one habit you have improved: what it was, how you changed it, and what you learnt. Try to use the past perfect passive (had been done).
writing.promptCn: 写一篇关于你改善的一个习惯的简短反思：它是什么、你怎样改变它、你学到了什么。试着用过去完成被动语态（had been done）。

quizQuestions.q: Checking my phone had ____ much of my free time.（占用）
We should not ____ on social media for every bit of news.（依赖）
A polite reminder shows you are ____ of others.（替他人着想的）
The school used a clever programme to ____ honesty.（提倡）
By the time the bell rang, the test papers ____ already.（被收走）
Before the detox started, over 100 students ____ to join.（被劝说）
By Friday, the whole project ____ two days early.（被完成）
Before Jack noticed it, a present ____ on his desk.（被留下）
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 一步一步地，他拖延的习惯被改掉了。
quizQuestions.audio: Step by step, his habit of delaying had been broken.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 被信任让学生更想做正确的事。
quizQuestions.audio: Being trusted made the students want to do the right thing.

listeningQuestions.audio: She switched off her phone before she started studying.
opts: 她一边学习一边玩手机。

listeningQuestions.audio: Much of his time had been occupied by checking messages.
opts: 他把时间都用来运动了。
他大量时间被查看消息占去了。

listeningQuestions.audio: By the end of term, every umbrella had been returned.
opts: 学期末每把伞都被归还了。

listeningQuestions.audio: The boy learnt to hold his temper instead of hammering nails.
opts: 男孩学会了控制脾气，而不是钉钉子。

listeningQuestions.audio: Saving a little each week gave her a clear goal.
opts: 每周存一点让她有了清晰的目标。

listeningQuestions.audio: Before the talk ended, several good examples had been given.
opts: 演讲结束前已给出几个好例子。

finalReading.passage: Leo had always put his homework off until midnight, and his marks had slowly dropped. One week he tried a new plan: he did his hardest subject first, right after school, before he even touched his phone. A month later his teachers noticed that his work had been handed in early for the first time, and Leo felt proud of how much had changed.

questions.q: What change did Leo make to his routine?
options: He tackled his most difficult subject before using his phone.
He stopped doing any homework at all.
He started staying up even later than before.
He gave his phone to his teacher.
questions.explanation: 原文 he did his hardest subject first … before he even touched his phone 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What did his teachers notice a month later?
options: His marks had dropped even further.
His assignments arrived ahead of time for once.
He had stopped coming to class.
He had lost interest in every subject.
questions.explanation: 末句 his work had been handed in early for the first time 的转述(覆盖短文后半段),非照抄。

units.title: Times Change!

lines.text: Grandpa, did you really read the news on paper every day?
lines.cn: 爷爷,你以前真的每天看纸质报纸吗?

lines.text: Yes. Each morning the papers were being delivered to our door.
lines.cn: 是啊。每天早上报纸都被送到我们家门口。

lines.text: Now I just read everything on my phone.
lines.cn: 现在我什么都在手机上看。

lines.text: Times change. The tools are new, but the news goes on.
lines.cn: 时代变了。工具是新的,但新闻一直都在。

lines.text: This old shop looks so different inside now!
lines.cn: 这家老店里面现在看起来太不一样了!

lines.text: When I came last week, the shelves were still being filled with new books.
lines.cn: 我上周来时,书架还在被摆上新书呢。

lines.text: And there's a café and a big screen for comments.
lines.cn: 而且还有咖啡馆和一块写评论的大屏幕。

lines.text: The community really brought it back to life.
lines.cn: 是社区真正让它重获新生。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 过去进行被动语态(was/were being done)

units.grammarTitle: 过去进行被动语态(was/were being done)

reading.passage: The Rainbow Bookstore was once closing after fifty years of business. But the local community joined together to save it, and today it is a lively place with a café, a big screen for readers' comments and even jazz concerts on some evenings.
reading.passageCn: 彩虹书店曾在经营五十年后面临关张。但当地社区齐心协力把它救了下来;如今它生机勃勃,有咖啡馆、供读者写评论的大屏幕,某些晚上还会举办爵士音乐会。

questions.q: Why is the Rainbow Bookstore still open today?
opts: Because the community worked together to save it.
Because a chain store bought it.
Because it never had any trouble.

questions.q: What can people enjoy in the store now?

writing.prompt: Write a short passage about one thing you think will disappear in the future. Say what it is, why it will disappear, and give one reason that supports your view.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇短文,谈一样你认为未来会消失的事物:它是什么、为什么会消失,并给出一条支持你看法的理由(试着用上过去进行被动,如 was being replaced)。

quizQuestions.q: The small shop could not ____ with the big chain stores on price.(竞争)
Under Jennifer's ____, the old bookstore came back to life.(领导)
Emojis now come in many ____, such as faces, animals and food.(类别)
More than forty years ago, China began the ____ and opening-up.(改革)
When I walked in, the books ____ into boxes at that very moment.
The old gate ____ down by the workers when I arrived.
Right then, the news ____ onto the website, line by line.
While the builders worked, the shop ____ into a modern café.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 南方各地正在修路、建厂。
quizQuestions.audio: Roads were being laid and factories were being built across the south.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 人们干脆不再需要那些旧电话亭了。
电话亭被搬进了博物馆。
quizQuestions.audio: People simply stopped needing the old phone boxes.

listeningQuestions.audio: When I arrived, the old books were already being packed into boxes.
opts: 我到的时候,旧书已经在被装进箱子里了。
我到的时候,新书正被摆上书架。
我到的时候,书店刚刚开门。
我到的时候,顾客在排队买书。

listeningQuestions.audio: Tall skyscrapers were being put up where the small fishing town had stood.
opts: 在小渔镇曾经矗立的地方,高楼正拔地而起。
小渔镇的渔船正被卖掉。
小镇周围的田地正在扩大。

listeningQuestions.audio: The corner board had been replaced by a big digital screen.
opts: 角落里的木板已被一块大数字屏幕取代。
角落里的屏幕被换成了木板。
角落里摆上了一台咖啡机。
角落里新建了一面玻璃墙。

listeningQuestions.audio: These days, most interviews are done online instead of face to face.
opts: 如今大多数采访都在线上进行,而不再面对面。
如今采访只能通过写信完成。
如今采访都在报纸上刊登。

listeningQuestions.audio: Emojis have become an integral part of the messages we send.
opts: 表情符号已成为我们所发信息中不可或缺的一部分。
表情符号正在被人们渐渐遗忘。
表情符号只能用于学校作业。
表情符号让拼写变得更容易。

listeningQuestions.audio: Like the phone box before it, the paper map is becoming a thing of the past.
opts: 就像之前的电话亭一样,纸质地图正在成为过去。
纸质地图正变得越来越流行。
电话亭又重新出现在街角。
人们重新开始使用纸质地图。

finalReading.passage: For years, the little village library lent paper books to everyone nearby. When a new digital reading room was opened last spring, the old wooden shelves were being cleared even as the first e-readers arrived. Today most villagers borrow books on a screen, yet a few elderly readers still ask for a real book they can hold.

questions.q: What was happening when the new reading room opened?
options: The old shelves were being emptied as e-readers came in.
New paper books were being delivered to every home.
The whole library was closing down for good.
Villagers were returning all of their screens.
questions.explanation: 原文 'the old wooden shelves were being cleared even as the first e-readers arrived' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What do a few elderly readers still prefer?
options: A faster Internet connection in the village.
A real paper book they can hold in their hands.
More screens for the digital reading room.
A brand-new library building nearby.
questions.explanation: 末句 'a few elderly readers still ask for a real book they can hold' 的转述(覆盖短文结尾)。

units.title: Breaking Boundaries

lines.text: Why do you want to volunteer in another country?
lines.cn: 你为什么想去另一个国家做志愿者?

lines.text: I think it is important to help people across borders.
lines.cn: 我觉得跨越国界帮助别人很重要。

lines.text: Aren't you worried about the language?
lines.cn: 你不担心语言问题吗?

lines.text: A little, but real care can cross any boundary.
lines.cn: 有点,但真正的关怀能跨越任何界限。

lines.text: Do you really think the world is getting smaller?
lines.cn: 你真觉得世界在变小吗?

lines.text: Yes. It seems that technology brings distant cultures together.
lines.cn: 是的。技术似乎把遥远的文化拉到了一起。

lines.text: So the boundaries between us are disappearing?
lines.cn: 所以我们之间的界限在消失?

lines.text: More like turning into bridges we can cross.
lines.cn: 更像是变成了我们可以跨越的桥。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 形式主语 it(It is + adj./n. + to do / that 从句)

units.grammarTitle: 形式主语 it(It is + adj./n. + to do / that 从句)

reading.passage: Doctors Without Borders brings medical care to people in danger, whatever country they come from. Its workers believe there are no borders for doctors or for patients. Those in the most serious danger are always treated first.
reading.passageCn: 无国界医生为身处危险中的人们带去医疗援助,无论他们来自哪个国家。其成员相信,对医生和病人而言都没有边界。最危急的人总是优先得到救治。

questions.q: Whom does the group help?
opts: People in danger from any country.

questions.q: Who is treated first?
opts: Those in the most serious danger.

writing.prompt: Write a short speech about a person who has helped to break boundaries between cultures or peoples. Say who the person is, what boundary he or she broke, and how you feel. Try to use formal-subject "it".
writing.promptCn: 写一篇短演讲,介绍一位帮助打破文化或人群之间界限的人:此人是谁、打破了什么界限、你的感受(试着用形式主语 it:It is … to do / It is … that …)。

quizQuestions.q: It is ____ not to take any chances during an outbreak.（极其重要的）
Different countries make a ____ effort to create a better world.（共同的）
Cultural exchange helps us become more ____.（包容的）
When cultures meet, both sides enjoy the ____ benefits.（共同的）
____ is important to remember that diseases respect no borders.
____ is true that no single country can fight an outbreak alone.
____ takes great courage to work in a disease clinic.
____ is no use worrying about culture shock at first.

opts: 他们从不放弃任何一位病人。
quizQuestions.audio: They never gave up on a single patient.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 如今世界感觉像一个大村庄。
quizQuestions.audio: Now the world feels like one big village.

listeningQuestions.audio: Doctors Without Borders helps people, whatever country they come from.
opts: 无国界医生帮助人们,无论他们来自哪个国家。
无国界医生只帮助本国人。
无国界医生是一家旅行公司。

listeningQuestions.audio: It is vital not to take any chances during an outbreak.
opts: 疫情期间可以随便冒险。
疫情爆发时绝不冒险是至关重要的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Technology has made it possible to connect with people across the world.
opts: 技术使我们能与世界各地的人相连。

listeningQuestions.audio: Lincoln's short speech gave his divided people new hope.
opts: 林肯的演说持续了一整天。
林肯简短的演说给分裂的人民带来新希望。

listeningQuestions.audio: Edgar Snow broke down boundaries of misunderstanding about China.
opts: 埃德加·斯诺打破了对中国的误解之界限。
埃德加·斯诺加深了人们的偏见。
埃德加·斯诺从未去过中国。
埃德加·斯诺只写欧洲的故事。

listeningQuestions.audio: Sport helps to break down the boundaries between strangers.
opts: 体育让陌生人更加疏远。
体育帮助打破陌生人之间的界限。

finalReading.passage: When Maria joined an international rescue team, she could barely speak the local language and felt completely out of place. Instead of staying silent, she learned a few useful phrases each day and let her willingness to help speak for her. Within a month, the whole team trusted her, and she realised that real care can cross any boundary.

questions.q: How did Maria feel when she first joined the team?
options: Confident and fully at home.
Out of place because of the language.
Bored with the rescue work.
Angry at her new colleagues.
questions.explanation: 原文'几乎不会说当地语言、感到格格不入'的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What did Maria realise within a month?
options: That she should give up and leave.
That language alone wins trust.
That sincere kindness can reach beyond any difference.
That the team did not need her.
questions.explanation: 末句'真正的关怀能跨越任何界限'的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: A Delicate World

lines.text: Why did the seabirds on the island almost disappear?
lines.cn: 为什么岛上的海鸟几乎消失了?

lines.text: People brought rats and cats, and they hunted the birds.
lines.cn: 人们带来了老鼠和猫,它们捕食了鸟。

lines.text: So how did people put things right?
lines.cn: 那人们是怎么补救的?

lines.text: They spent years removing the pests with traps and dogs.
lines.cn: 他们花了数年用陷阱和狗清除害兽。

lines.text: It's sad how one small change can upset a whole ecosystem.
lines.cn: 一个小变化就能扰乱整个生态系统,真令人难过。

lines.text: True. That's why every species matters, however small.
lines.cn: 是啊,所以每个物种都重要,无论多小。

lines.text: We should make it a habit to protect wild places.
lines.cn: 我们应该养成保护野生之地的习惯。

lines.text: Agreed. Small daily actions can really make a difference.
lines.cn: 同意。日常的小行动真的能带来改变。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 形式宾语 it(find/think/make it + adj. + to do / that)

All the birds left the island.

questions.q: Why did the rabbit numbers explode again?
opts: They had become immune to the virus.

兔子被人们带离了小岛。

listeningQuestions.audio: Shennongjia was added to the World Heritage List in 2016.
opts: 神农架于2016年被列入世界遗产名录。
神农架从未进入世界遗产名录。

listeningQuestions.audio: In winter, scientists carry food up the mountain for the golden monkeys.
opts: 冬天,科学家们把食物背上山喂金丝猴。
冬天,科学家们把金丝猴带下山。
冬天,科学家们停止研究金丝猴。
金丝猴冬天会自己下山找人。

listeningQuestions.audio: By giving the bees a secure home, the villagers collect honey in return.
opts: 村民给蜜蜂安全的家,作为回报采集蜂蜜。
村民把蜜蜂赶出了村子。
村民从不靠近这些蜜蜂。
蜜蜂偷走了村民的蜂蜜。

listeningQuestions.audio: In 2014 the island was finally declared free of pests.
opts: 2014年,这座岛终于被宣布无害兽。

finalReading.passage: When Lin joined a beach clean-up for the first time, she was shocked by how much plastic lay among the rocks. She and her friends filled twenty large bags in a single afternoon, and seabirds soon returned to feed where the rubbish had been. Lin says the day taught her that even one free Saturday can make a real difference to the natural world.

questions.q: Why was Lin shocked at the beach?
options: There was a great deal of plastic among the rocks.
There were no rocks on the beach at all.
The sea had completely dried up.
She could not find any of her friends.
questions.explanation: 原文 'shocked by how much plastic lay among the rocks' 的转述;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: What lesson did Lin learn from the day?
options: Cleaning beaches is a waste of time.
Even a little effort can really help nature.
Only scientists can protect the sea.
Seabirds should be kept away from beaches.
questions.explanation: 末句 'even one free Saturday can make a real difference to the natural world' 的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Survival

lines.text: We've lost the path. What should we do now?
lines.cn: 我们找不到路了,现在该怎么办?

lines.text: Stay calm. Whatever happens, we must not split up.
lines.cn: 保持冷静。无论发生什么,我们都不能走散。

lines.text: Should we keep walking to look for the way?
lines.cn: 我们要继续走着找路吗?

lines.text: No. Wherever we are, it's safer to stay here and wait for help.
lines.cn: 不。无论我们在哪里,待在原地等救援都更安全。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: -ever 与 no matter 引导的状语从句(whatever/wherever/however…)

units.grammarTitle: -ever 与 no matter 引导的状语从句(whatever/wherever/however…)

reading.passage: A young fox slips into the streets of London at night to look for food. Far from the larger animals that once hunted it, the fox feels safe in the city. It opens bins, eats our leftovers, and has truly become a city animal.
reading.passageCn: 夜里,一只年幼的狐狸溜进伦敦的街道找吃的。由于远离了曾经捕猎它的大型动物,这只狐狸在城里感到安全。它翻开垃圾箱,吃我们的剩饭,如今已经真正成了一只城市动物。

questions.q: Why does the fox come into the city at night?
Why does the fox feel safe in the city?
opts: It is far from the animals that once hunted it.
People keep it as a pet.

questions.q: What has the fox become?

writing.prompt: In about 60 words, write a short survival story about being lost in the wild. Use at least one clause with -ever or no matter.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一个在野外迷路的小求生故事,至少用上一个 -ever 或 no matter 引导的从句。

quizQuestions.q: '郊区、城郊'对应哪个词?
'估计、估算'用哪个动词?
'至关重要的'用哪个形容词?
急救包:a first-aid ____
____ happens in the wild, a calm mind helps you survive.
____ hard the climb was, the team kept going.
____ reaches the survivor first should keep him warm.
____ a wildfire breaks out, leave the area calmly.
听句子选中文:
opts: 每当危机出现,冷静的人会寻找解决办法。
危机出现时最好先逃跑。
冷静的人从不遇到危机。
quizQuestions.audio: Whenever a crisis appears, calm people look for a solution.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 城市里的狐狸怕人不敢出来。
城市里的狐狸已学会与我们为邻而居。
quizQuestions.audio: The urban fox has learned to live right beside us.

listeningQuestions.audio: Wherever they go, wild animals find our cities in their way.
opts: 野生动物无论走到哪里,都发现城市挡在前路。
野生动物只在夜里才进城。
野生动物从不靠近城市。
城市里根本没有野生动物。

listeningQuestions.audio: Scientists estimate that up to a billion birds die from window crashes each year.
opts: 科学家说鸟类从不撞窗。
科学家估计每年多达十亿只鸟死于撞窗。
科学家认为撞窗对鸟无害。
科学家说只有一只鸟撞窗。

listeningQuestions.audio: Wherever you go in the wild, take a first-aid kit with you.
opts: 在野外把急救包留在家里。
只有受伤时才需要急救包。
在野外无论去哪儿,都要随身带急救包。
急救包在野外没什么用。

listeningQuestions.audio: However hard the situation seems, stay calm and keep hoping.
opts: 无论情况多难,都要保持冷静、心怀希望。

listeningQuestions.audio: No matter what happens, a calm mind is the best survival tool.
opts: 无论发生什么,冷静的头脑是最好的求生工具。

listeningQuestions.audio: As cities become greener, they offer good homes to wild animals.
opts: 城市越变越绿,野生动物就越少。
城市越变越绿,为野生动物提供了好家园。
绿色城市会赶走所有动物。
城市变绿和动物毫无关系。

finalReading.passage: When a sudden storm trapped Daniel in a mountain cave, he did not panic. Whatever the cold night threw at him, he kept calm, lit a small fire, and waited for the rescue team. By morning, his steady, hopeful mind had carried him safely through the danger.

questions.q: How did Daniel react when the storm trapped him?
options: He stayed calm instead of panicking.
He shouted and ran out into the storm.
He gave up all hope at once.
He fell asleep and forgot the cold.
questions.explanation: 对 'he did not panic… he kept calm' 的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: What mainly helped Daniel survive the night?
options: A passing climber who found him.
His calm and hopeful state of mind.
A warm house near the cave.
The bright sunshine all night long.
questions.explanation: 对末句 'his steady, hopeful mind had carried him safely through the danger' 的转述(短文后半,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: It's All About Me!

dialogues.title: You Look Great As You Are

lines.text: I've taken twenty selfies, but none of them looks good enough to post.
lines.cn: 我拍了二十张自拍,但没一张好到能发出去。

lines.text: Honestly, you look better in the real ones. Why edit your face so much?
lines.cn: 说实话,你真实的照片更好看。为什么要把脸修那么多?

lines.text: I just feel my real face isn't pretty enough for everyone to see.
lines.cn: 我只是觉得真脸不够好看,不好意思给大家看。

lines.text: What matters is the true you. The people who care will like that most.
lines.cn: 重要的是真实的你。在乎你的人最喜欢的就是这个。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 主语从句(what/that/whether + 从句作主语;形式主语 it)

units.grammarTitle: 主语从句(what/that/whether + 从句作主语;形式主语 it)

reading.passage: We often judge a new person within just a few seconds, and a neat appearance can leave a warm first impression. Yet that impression is only the cover of a long book. What truly makes people attractive is kindness, honesty and a confident heart.
reading.passageCn: 我们常常几秒钟就对一个新认识的人下判断,整洁的外表能留下温暖的第一印象。但那印象只是一本厚书的封面。真正让人有魅力的,是善良、诚实和一颗自信的心。

questions.q: What can a neat appearance leave, according to the passage?
What truly makes people attractive?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a person you find truly beautiful. Say who they are and why, using at least two subject clauses (e.g. What impresses me most is …, It is true that …).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写一个你认为真正美的人:他/她是谁、为什么美,至少用两个主语从句(如 What impresses me most is …, It is true that …)。

quizQuestions.q: Her father called her a ____ for editing so many selfies.
Inner beauty matters most, but outer beauty should not be ____.
She stayed confident in an industry full of beauty ____.
Being reviewed from head to toe felt ____ to him at first.
____ makes a person beautiful is not only a pretty face.
____ good health makes us happier is now widely accepted.
____ external beauty really matters is still debated by many.
____ is important that we accept who we really are.
听句子选中文:
opts: 他对自己说话的方式比镜子更重要。
我们一个接一个地自我介绍。
quizQuestions.audio: The way you speak to yourself matters more than any mirror.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 无论你在网上发什么,都可能永远留在那里。
quizQuestions.audio: Whatever you post online may stay there forever.

listeningQuestions.audio: What I show online is only the happiest part of my life.
opts: 我在网上展示的只是生活中最快乐的部分。

listeningQuestions.audio: It is true that real beauty comes from within.
opts: 真正的美源自内心,这是真的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Whoever accepts herself first will find real confidence.
opts: 谁先接受自己,谁就能找到真正的自信。

listeningQuestions.audio: After the makeover, he finally saw himself as handsome.
opts: 形象改造之后,他终于觉得自己很帅。

listeningQuestions.audio: What truly matters is who you are on the inside.
opts: 真正要紧的是你内心是怎样的人。
他把秘密告诉了所有人。

listeningQuestions.audio: Whether looks really matter is still debated by many.
opts: 外貌是否真的重要,许多人仍在争论。

finalReading.passage: Daniel used to compare himself with everyone he saw online, and he always felt that he came up short. One afternoon his little sister asked him why the boy in his photos never smiled the way he did at home. Her honest question made him realise that the perfect images were hiding the cheerful, kind person he truly was.

questions.q: How did Daniel feel when he compared himself with people online?
options: He felt he was not good enough.
He felt proud and satisfied.
He felt bored and sleepy.
He felt richer than them.
questions.explanation: 原文 'always felt that he came up short' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What did his sister's question help Daniel understand?
options: That he should take more photos.
That his edited images hid his real, cheerful self.
That he needed a better phone.
That his sister disliked his pictures.
questions.explanation: 末句 '…hiding the cheerful, kind person he truly was' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Life Behind the Lens

lines.text: Have you heard of Bill Cunningham, the street photographer?
lines.cn: 你听说过街拍摄影师比尔·坎宁安吗?

lines.text: Yes! What I admire most is that he photographed ordinary people.
lines.cn: 听过!我最敬佩的是他拍的是普通人。

lines.text: And the reason his photos feel so alive is that they show real life.
lines.cn: 他的照片之所以那么生动,是因为它们展现的是真实生活。

lines.text: That is why he is still remembered today.
lines.cn: 这就是为什么他至今仍被人铭记。

lines.text: Why does it take months to repair one old clock?
lines.cn: 为什么修一座老钟要花好几个月?

lines.text: The reason is that every tiny part must be cleaned by hand.
lines.cn: 原因是每个细小的部件都必须手工清洁。

lines.text: This is what real craftsmanship looks like, isn't it?
lines.cn: 这就是真正匠心的样子,对吧?

lines.text: Exactly. That is why we should respect these quiet masters.
lines.cn: 正是。这就是我们该尊敬这些默默无闻的大师的原因。

units.grammarTitle: 表语从句(This is what/why/because…)

reading.passage: Bill Cunningham was a famous fashion photographer, yet his life was wonderfully simple. He rode an old bicycle, wore the same plain jacket, and went out every single day to photograph ordinary people on the streets of New York. To him, freedom mattered far more than money.
reading.passageCn: 比尔·坎宁安是著名的时尚摄影师,但他的生活却出奇地简单。他骑一辆旧自行车,穿同一件朴素外套,每天都出门去拍摄纽约街头的普通人。对他来说,自由远比金钱重要。

questions.q: What was Cunningham's life like?
What mattered more to him than money?

writing.prompt: Write about 60 words about a person who shows the spirit of craftsmanship. Use at least one predicative clause (e.g. This is what… / The reason … is that…).
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一位体现匠心精神的人物,至少用一个表语从句(如 This is what… / The reason … is that…)。

quizQuestions.q: He never used costly cameras; he stayed focused on his ____ instead.
Each old clock needs its own careful method of ____.
He sought no fame and chose to ____ the spotlight all his life.
These masters work with skilful hands and ____ hearts, seeking no praise.
Hard work and devotion are ____ made Bill Cunningham so special.
The simple truth is ____ he never took a single day off.
The reason his photos look so alive is ____ he always shot real people.
A small restaurant was ____ he ate the same breakfast every day.
听句子选中文:
opts: 让他的工作如此特别的,是他全然的专注。
他更看重金钱而非手艺。
quizQuestions.audio: What makes his work so special is his complete devotion to the craft.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 今天细心的观察者,明天可以成为真正的艺术家。
只有昂贵的相机才能拍出好照片。
艺术家不需要任何耐心。
他从不观察周围的世界。
quizQuestions.audio: A careful observer today can become a true artist tomorrow.

listeningQuestions.audio: Bill Cunningham rode an old bicycle around New York and photographed ordinary people.
opts: 比尔·坎宁安骑着旧自行车在纽约街头拍摄普通人。
比尔从不离开他的摄影棚。
比尔每天都在修理自行车。

listeningQuestions.audio: This is what makes his photos so special: he went out in every kind of weather.
opts: 他从来不在坏天气出门。
让他的照片如此特别的,是他在各种天气都坚持出门。

listeningQuestions.audio: In a quiet courtyard, Wang Jin spends his days repairing antique clocks by hand.
opts: 王津用机器快速修理钟表。
在安静的庭院里,王津每天用手修复古董钟表。
王津只修现代的电子表。

listeningQuestions.audio: The reason each clock takes months is that every tiny part must be cleaned by hand.
opts: 每件钟表要花数月,是因为每个小部件都得手工清洁。

listeningQuestions.audio: A good photographer is first of all a careful observer of everyday life.
opts: 好的摄影师首先是日常生活的细心观察者。
好的摄影师只需昂贵的相机。
好的摄影师从不看周围的人。

listeningQuestions.audio: When the old clock chimes again, that sound is the finest music in the world to him.
opts: 当老钟再次报时,那声音对他来说是世上最美的音乐。

finalReading.passage: When Tom visited an old toy maker, he expected to buy a finished wooden train. Instead, the old man invited him to sit down and carve a small wheel himself, slowly and by hand. Two hours later Tom held a single rough wheel, yet he felt prouder of it than of any toy he had ever bought.

questions.q: What had Tom planned to do at the toy maker's shop?
options: Sit and watch other children play.
Buy a ready-made wooden train.
Sell some old toys of his own.
Learn to paint a picture.
questions.explanation: 由 'he expected to buy a finished wooden train' 转述;其余短文未提或相反。

questions.q: Why did Tom feel proud at the end?
options: He had made the small wheel with his own hands.
He had bought the most expensive toy.
He had finished the work in two minutes.
He had taught the old man a new skill.
questions.explanation: 由末句 'he felt prouder of it than of any toy he had ever bought'(短文后半,覆盖不同位置)结合他亲手雕轮转述。

units.title: The D-Day Landings

lines.text: Have you finished reading about the D-Day landings?
lines.cn: 你读完关于诺曼底登陆的内容了吗?

lines.text: Yes. The whole army was ready, yet the fighting on Omaha Beach was terrible.
lines.cn: 读完了。整支部队都准备好了,可奥马哈海滩的战斗太可怕了。

lines.text: I know. A number of boats were hit before they reached the sand.
lines.cn: 是啊。许多船在到达海滩前就被击中了。

lines.text: Their courage changed the course of the war, though. We should remember them.
lines.cn: 不过他们的勇气改变了战争走向。我们应当铭记他们。

lines.text: Why does our teacher want us to study so many old wars?
lines.cn: 老师为什么要我们学这么多旧战争?

lines.text: Because the number of people who remember them is getting smaller every year.
lines.cn: 因为记得这些事的人一年比一年少。

lines.text: So learning about war helps us value peace?
lines.cn: 所以了解战争能让我们珍惜和平?

lines.text: Exactly. Remembering the past is the first step towards keeping the peace.
lines.cn: 正是。铭记过去是守护和平的第一步。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 主谓一致1(集合名词/and 连接/就近原则)

units.grammarTitle: 主谓一致1(集合名词/and 连接/就近原则)

reading.passage: Operation Overlord was the largest sea, air and land attack in history. Its aim was to free western Europe, and after years of secret planning it began on 6 June 1944. Though the cost in lives was high, the landings marked the beginning of the end of the war.
reading.passageCn: “霸王行动”是历史上最大规模的海陆空联合进攻。它的目标是解放西欧,经过数年秘密筹划,于1944年6月6日打响。尽管生命代价高昂,登陆却标志着战争走向终结的开端。

questions.q: What was the aim of Operation Overlord?
What did the landings mark?
opts: The beginning of the end of the war.
The very start of the war.
A long peace before the war.

writing.prompt: Write a few sentences reviewing a war film you have seen. Say its name and director, describe one scene, and explain the message it sends about war and peace. Try to keep your subjects and verbs in agreement (e.g. the team is …, a number of soldiers were …).
writing.promptCn: 写几句话评价一部你看过的战争电影:说出片名和导演,描述一个场景,并说明它传达的关于战争与和平的信息。注意主谓一致(如 the team is …,a number of soldiers were …)。

quizQuestions.q: The general gave the order to ____ the city from the enemy.(解放)
Thousands of soldiers landed by ____ behind enemy lines.(降落伞)
Chinese peacekeepers are praised for their ____.(专业素质)
Every year people hold a ____ ceremony for the dead.(纪念的)
The whole army ____ ready to cross the Channel before dawn.
A number of boats ____ hit by enemy fire that morning.
The number of casualties ____ rising hour by hour.
Bread and butter ____ all the soldiers had to eat at dawn.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 指挥官等待合适的天气和潮水才下令进攻。
指挥官不顾天气立刻进攻。
quizQuestions.audio: The commander waited for the right weather and tide before ordering the attack.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 这些维和人员帮助交战各方遵守和平协议。
维和人员向当地出售武器。
维和人员只是袖手旁观。
维和人员发动了一场战争。
quizQuestions.audio: The peacekeepers help the warring sides keep to their peace agreement.

listeningQuestions.audio: The D-Day landings began at dawn on the sixth of June, 1944.
opts: 诺曼底登陆于1944年6月6日黎明开始。
诺曼底登陆从未真正发生过。
登陆是在深夜十二点开始的。

listeningQuestions.audio: The enemy were hiding above the beach, ready to attack the soldiers.
opts: 敌人埋伏在海滩上方,准备攻击士兵。
敌人在海滩上欢迎士兵。

listeningQuestions.audio: By the end of August, the Allies had liberated Paris.
opts: 到八月底,同盟国已解放了巴黎。
到八月底,巴黎被敌人占领。

listeningQuestions.audio: Each soldier was given a parachute before the night jump.
opts: 每名士兵在夜间跳伞前都领到一具降落伞。
士兵们没有任何降落伞。

listeningQuestions.audio: Today China plays an important role in UN peacekeeping.
opts: 如今中国在联合国维和行动中发挥重要作用。
中国从不参加维和行动。
中国只派出一名维和人员。

listeningQuestions.audio: We will remember the brave soldiers who never came home.
opts: 我们会铭记那些再未归来的勇敢士兵。
我们已经忘记了那些士兵。
所有士兵都平安回家了。

finalReading.passage: In a small French village near the coast stands a single stone, no taller than a child. It marks the spot where a young Canadian soldier fell on the first morning of the landings, far from his home. Every June, the villagers still place fresh flowers at its foot, so that a stranger who died for them will never be forgotten.

questions.q: Why was the stone put up in the village?
options: To mark where a young soldier died during the landings.
To show visitors the way down to the beach.
To celebrate the founding of the village.
To remember a famous local farmer.
questions.explanation: 短文说石碑标记一名年轻士兵阵亡之处,选项为转述;其余原文未提或相反。

questions.q: What do the villagers do every June?
options: They hold a large summer market.
They lay fresh flowers at the stone.
They rebuild the old stone each year.
They leave the village for the coast.
questions.explanation: 末句说村民每年六月在石碑脚下献上鲜花,选项转述了这一行为。

questions.q: Why do the villagers still honour the soldier?
options: Because he was born in their village.
Because he built the stone himself.
Because he died for them though he was a stranger.
Because he was a famous general.
questions.explanation: 短文说一个为他们而死的陌生人不会被遗忘,故村民铭记这位远道而来的陌生士兵。

units.title: Artificial Intelligence: A Real Threat?

lines.text: Do you think machines will really take our jobs?
lines.cn: 你觉得机器真的会抢走我们的工作吗?

lines.text: Some jobs, maybe. Almost half of them are at risk one day.
lines.cn: 也许会有一些。某些工作有朝一日近一半都面临风险。

lines.text: That sounds frightening. What can we do about it?
lines.cn: 听起来挺吓人的。我们能做些什么呢?

lines.text: Keep learning new skills, so we stay useful beside the machines.
lines.cn: 不断学习新技能,这样我们就能在机器旁边继续发挥作用。

lines.text: Could a robot ever be a real friend, do you think?
lines.cn: 你觉得机器人能成为真正的朋友吗?

lines.text: Maybe friendship is more about feelings than about metal.
lines.cn: 也许友谊更多关乎感情,而不是金属。

lines.text: But a machine only acts as though it cares.
lines.cn: 可机器只是装作在乎罢了。

lines.text: True. In the end, a person decides what really matters.
lines.cn: 没错。归根结底,是人来决定什么才真正重要。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 主谓一致2(分数/百分比/不定代词/the number of…)

units.grammarTitle: 主谓一致2(分数/百分比/不定代词/the number of…)

reading.passage: AI is no longer science fiction; it is already part of daily life. Used wisely, it can help us a great deal, but a person, not a machine, is always responsible for how it is used.
reading.passageCn: 人工智能不再是科幻;它已是日常生活的一部分。善加利用,它能给我们很大帮助,但对它如何被使用负责的,永远是人,而非机器。

questions.q: Who is always responsible for how AI is used?
When can AI help us a great deal?

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph giving your opinion on the question "Is AI a real threat?" State your view, give one reason with an example, and end with a balanced conclusion. Pay attention to subject-verb agreement.
writing.promptCn: 就"AI 是真正的威胁吗?"写一小段,亮明观点、给一条理由并举例,最后给出平衡的结论。注意主谓一致(分数/百分比、none、there be)。

quizQuestions.q: Much of the value of AI lies in its ____ to analyse data.（能力）
Taxi drivers may be among the first ____ of automation.（受害者）
We have no choice but to embrace AI and ____ it.（管理）
AI doctors are on the ____, even if they are not here yet.（即将到来）
Almost 50 per cent of US jobs ____ at risk from automation.
None of us ____ fully prepared for the challenges of AI.
Neither the cars nor the robot ____ truly alive.
There ____ a few machine-learning problems when the first cars arrive.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 不止一位专家警告过我们人工智能的风险。
没有专家担心人工智能。
人工智能没有任何风险。
quizQuestions.audio: More than one expert has warned us about the risks of AI.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 面临风险的工作数量保持不变。
面临风险的工作数量逐年上升。
quizQuestions.audio: The number of jobs at risk is rising every year.

listeningQuestions.audio: Much of the value of AI lies in its capacity to analyse data.
opts: AI 的价值大多在于它分析数据的能力。
AI 无法分析任何东西。

listeningQuestions.audio: Almost 50 per cent of US jobs are at risk from automation.
opts: 近一半的美国工作面临自动化的风险。

listeningQuestions.audio: We have no choice but to embrace AI and regulate it.
opts: 我们应当彻底禁止 AI。
我们应当完全忽视 AI。
我们别无选择,只能接纳并管理 AI。

listeningQuestions.audio: None of us is fully prepared for the challenges of AI.
opts: 我们都已为 AI 做好准备。
我们没有谁为 AI 的挑战做好充分准备。

listeningQuestions.audio: A self-driving car can make judgements based on information.
opts: 自动驾驶汽车能根据信息作出判断。
自动驾驶汽车从不收集信息。
自动驾驶汽车只会停在原地。
自动驾驶汽车需要司机帮忙。

listeningQuestions.audio: AI is not magic, and it is not something to fear.
opts: AI 不是魔法,也不必害怕。

finalReading.passage: When Grandpa first heard about AI doctors, he laughed and said that no machine could ever care for a patient. A year later, a smart program spotted his heart problem early, and the real doctors used its warning to treat him in time. Now Grandpa says that the cleverest care appears when people and machines work side by side.

questions.q: How did Grandpa feel about AI doctors at first?
options: He doubted that a machine could care for patients.
He trusted them completely at once.
He decided to build one himself.
He had never heard of them before.
questions.explanation: 原文 'he laughed and said that no machine could ever care for a patient' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What does Grandpa believe now?
options: People should never rely on machines.
The best care comes when people and machines cooperate.
Human doctors are no longer needed.
AI doctors should be banned everywhere.
questions.explanation: 末句 'the cleverest care appears when people and machines work side by side' 的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Nature in Architecture

lines.text: Have you seen the new building that looks like a lotus?
lines.cn: 你见过那座像莲花的新建筑吗?

lines.text: Yes! Its roof collects rainwater and uses it again.
lines.cn: 见过!它的屋顶收集雨水并循环利用。

lines.text: Designing something like that must be really hard.
lines.cn: 设计那样的东西一定很难。

lines.text: It is, but copying nature often gives the best ideas.
lines.cn: 是很难,但模仿自然常常带来最好的点子。

lines.text: Why do you want plants on the school roof?
lines.cn: 你为什么想在校园屋顶种植物?

lines.text: Growing plants up there keeps the rooms cool in summer.
lines.cn: 在那上面种植物能让房间夏天保持凉爽。

lines.text: Good idea. Who will water them in the holidays?
lines.cn: 好主意。假期里谁来浇水呢?

lines.text: We'll collect rainwater, so saving water is easy.
lines.cn: 我们会收集雨水,所以节约用水很容易。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 非谓语作主语/宾语/表语(to do · doing 综合)

units.grammarTitle: 非谓语作主语/宾语/表语(to do · doing 综合)

reading.passage: A new school in the city has green plants growing all over its walls. The leaves give cool shade in summer and let warm sunlight through in winter, so the rooms stay comfortable without using much power.
reading.passageCn: 城里一所新学校的墙上爬满了绿色植物。夏天树叶带来凉爽的树荫,冬天又让温暖的阳光透进来,所以房间无需耗费太多电力就能保持舒适。

questions.q: Why do the rooms stay comfortable all year?
opts: Because wall plants give shade in summer and let in winter sun.
Because the school is built deep underground.
Because strong heaters run all day long.
Because every window is always left open.

questions.q: What grows all over the school walls?

writing.prompt: Write a short passage to introduce a building that learns from nature. Say what gave the designer the idea, how the building works, and why it is good for the environment. Try to use non-finite forms (Copying nature is…, His goal is to…, Using less energy…).
writing.promptCn: 写一篇短文,介绍一座向自然学习的建筑:灵感来自什么、它如何运作、为何对环境有益。试着用非谓语结构(Copying nature is…、His goal is to…、Using less energy…)。

quizQuestions.q: The Eastgate Centre is a ____ example of biomimicry.（出色的）
Solar panels can ____ sunlight into electricity.（转化）
Architects often ____ the way nature solves problems.（模仿）
Living simply close to nature can bring deep ____.（满足感）
____ inspiration from nature is an old tradition among architects.
The architect decided ____ the museum like a lotus flower.
Her main job is ____ green buildings for schools.
Designing such complex buildings ____ years of patient study.
quizQuestions.point: 非谓语作主语·主谓一致

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 屋顶收集雨水并循环利用。
quizQuestions.audio: The roof collects rainwater and uses it again.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 通过观察蜻蜓,人们造出更好的无人机。
quizQuestions.audio: By watching dragonflies, people built better drones.

listeningQuestions.audio: The museum was shaped to look like a giant lotus flower.
opts: 博物馆被设计成巨大的莲花形状。
博物馆很快就要拆掉了。

listeningQuestions.audio: Holes in the termite mound let air move in and out.
opts: 白蚁土丘上的孔让空气进出。

listeningQuestions.audio: The green panels turn sunlight into clean energy.
opts: 绿色面板把阳光变成清洁能源。
面板只是普通的玻璃窗。

listeningQuestions.audio: Collecting rainwater helps the building save water.
opts: 这座建筑浪费了很多水。
收集雨水帮建筑节约用水。

listeningQuestions.audio: Thoreau lived alone in a small cottage by a pond.
opts: 梭罗独自住在池塘边的小屋里。
梭罗住在城市的高楼里。

listeningQuestions.audio: Engineers copied a bird's beak to build faster trains.
opts: 工程师模仿鸟喙造出更快的列车。

finalReading.passage: When Maria was asked to design a new bus station, she covered its roof with grass and wild flowers. The green roof keeps the building cool in summer, soaks up rainwater, and gives bees a place to feed. Today travellers say that waiting for a bus there feels almost like sitting in a small park.

questions.q: What did Maria do to the roof of the bus station?
options: She planted grass and flowers on it.
She painted it bright red.
She covered it with glass panels.
She left it completely bare.
questions.explanation: 原文说她在屋顶覆盖青草与野花,选项是其转述,而非原文连续词串。

questions.q: What is one benefit of the green roof?
options: It makes the station hotter in summer.
It keeps the building cool and stores rainwater.
It blocks all the daylight inside.
It frightens away every insect.
questions.explanation: 原文说屋顶夏天降温、吸收雨水,选项是其概括;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: How do travellers feel about waiting there now?
options: It is noisy and unpleasant.
It is the same as any other station.
It is like relaxing in a tiny park.
It is too crowded to enjoy.
questions.explanation: 末句说在那里等车几乎像在小公园里,选项是其转述。

units.title: First Snow

lines.text: Look, it snowed last night! The whole garden is white.
lines.cn: 看,昨晚下雪了!整个花园都白了。

lines.text: Let's go outside. I want to build a snowman with you.
lines.cn: 我们出去吧,我想和你一起堆雪人。

lines.text: Good idea! But put on your gloves — it's freezing.
lines.cn: 好主意!不过戴上手套,天很冷。

lines.text: Standing in the falling snow, I feel like a happy child again.
lines.cn: 站在纷飞的雪中,我感觉又像个快乐的孩子。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 非谓语作定语/状语/补语(doing · done 综合)

units.grammarTitle: 非谓语作定语/状语/补语(doing · done 综合)

reading.passage: On the first snowy morning, the children pressed their faces to the cold window and watched the white flakes drift down. They could hardly wait to put on their coats and run outside to play.
reading.passageCn: 在初雪的早晨,孩子们把脸贴在冰冷的窗户上,看着白色的雪花飘落。他们迫不及待地想穿上外套跑出去玩。

questions.q: What did the children watch from the window?
What did the children want to do?

writing.prompt: Describe the first snow you remember. Say what the snowy world looked like and how you felt. Try to use non-finite verbs, such as 'the falling snow' or 'Looking out of the window, I saw …'.
writing.promptCn: 描写你记得的一场初雪:说说雪后的世界是什么样子,你有什么感受。试着用上非谓语动词,如 the falling snow 或 Looking out of the window, I saw …。

quizQuestions.q: The very ____ and quietness of the snow made it feel magical.
By noon the bright ____ of the white snow had completely gone.
The morning sun began to ____ the white snow with delicate pink.
Carson's long list of sources showed how ____ a scientist she was.
From my study I can see the children ____ their noses against the window.
____ with deep snow, the open fields looked like a white sea.
I watched the soft snow ____ quietly past the bright street lamp.
She was the only child ____ outside into the cold winter storm.
Listen: 'The first snow fell quietly during the night.' When did the first snow fall?
quizQuestions.audio: The first snow fell quietly during the night.

quizQuestions.q: Listen: 'Heavy snow made all the trees bend low.' What did the heavy snow do to the trees?
quizQuestions.audio: Heavy snow made all the trees bend low.

listeningQuestions.audio: The first snow fell quietly during the night.
opts: 初雪在夜里静静地落下。

listeningQuestions.audio: Looking out of the window, I saw the falling snow.
opts: 望向窗外,我看见纷飞的雪。
我看见花园里的花开了。

listeningQuestions.audio: The little plum tree was covered with soft white snow.
opts: 那棵小李树盖满了柔软的白雪。
那棵小李树被风吹倒了。
那棵小李树上结满了果子。

listeningQuestions.audio: I could see the children flattening their noses against the glass.
opts: 我能看见孩子们把鼻子贴在玻璃上。
我能听见孩子们在大声唱歌。

listeningQuestions.audio: Heavy snow made all the trees bend low.
opts: 厚厚的雪把所有的树都压弯了。
大风把所有的树都吹倒了。
阳光让所有的树长得更高。
雨水让所有的花都开了。

listeningQuestions.audio: The first snow turned an ordinary morning into something magical.
opts: 初雪把平凡的早晨变得神奇。
初雪让早晨变得很无聊。
初雪很快就融化不见了。
初雪让人们都待在家里工作。

finalReading.passage: When Lily woke up last Sunday, she found her small village completely hidden under fresh snow. Instead of staying in bed, she put on her warmest coat and ran outside to join her friends. Together they built a tall snowman and threw soft snowballs until their hands were freezing.

questions.q: What did Lily find when she woke up?
options: Her village was covered with fresh snow.
The snow had all melted away.
Her friends had already gone home.
It was a hot summer day.
questions.explanation: 原文'her small village completely hidden under fresh snow'的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What did Lily do instead of staying in bed?
options: She put on a coat and went out to her friends.
She went straight back to sleep.
She read a book by the window.
She watched television all morning.
questions.explanation: 原文'put on her warmest coat and ran outside to join her friends'的转述(短文中段)。

questions.q: How were their hands at the end?
options: Warm and completely dry.
Very cold from the snow.
Hurt and bleeding.
Covered in bright paint.
questions.explanation: 末句'until their hands were freezing'的转述(短文末尾,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Facing the Future

dialogues.title: What Are You Going to Do?

lines.text: Have you decided what you want to do after senior high?
lines.cn: 你想好高中毕业后做什么了吗?

lines.text: I think I'm going to study clean energy. I want to help fight climate change.
lines.cn: 我打算学清洁能源,想帮助应对气候变化。

lines.text: That sounds great. The world will need a lot more clean energy in the future.
lines.cn: 听起来很棒。未来世界会需要更多清洁能源。

lines.text: Exactly. Whatever happens, I'll keep learning and stay ready for change.
lines.cn: 正是。无论发生什么,我都会不断学习,随时准备迎接改变。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 时态综合复习(过去/现在/将来 各时态辨析与运用)

units.grammarTitle: 时态综合复习(过去/现在/将来 各时态辨析与运用)

reading.passage: Nobody can be sure what the world will look like in twenty years. Yet the people who do well are usually those who keep learning, stay flexible, and are not afraid of change. Instead of fearing the future, they prepare for it and help to build it.
reading.passageCn: 没人能确定二十年后的世界是什么样子。但通常过得好的人,是那些不断学习、保持灵活、不惧改变的人。他们不害怕未来,而是为未来做准备并参与创造未来。

questions.q: Who usually does well in the future, according to the passage?
opts: People who keep learning and stay flexible.
People who fear every new idea.

questions.q: What do these people do instead of fearing the future?
opts: They prepare for it and help build it.
They wait for others to act.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about your own plans for the future. Say what you are going to do and why, using at least two different future forms (e.g. I'm going to …, I will …, By 2030 I will have …).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写写你对未来的打算:你打算做什么、为什么,至少用两种不同的将来表达(如 I'm going to …, I will …, By 2030 I will have …)。

quizQuestions.q: It would be a pity to ____ up such a wonderful opportunity.
Let's ____ up the options carefully before we decide.
Having a plan is no ____ that everything will come true.
We should face our future with energy and ____.
By the time you come back next month, our team ____ the project.
Look! The delivery robot ____ towards the gate right now.
She told me on Monday that she ____ to study robotics the next year.
At this time next year, many of us ____ at university.
听句子选中文:
opts: 每一个选择都在帮助塑造你想要的未来。
我们一个接一个地自我介绍。
quizQuestions.audio: Every choice helps to shape the future you want.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 这段经历会让我更独立、更成熟。
quizQuestions.audio: The experience will make me more independent and mature.

listeningQuestions.audio: What will we be doing in ten years' time?
opts: 十年后我们会在做什么呢?

listeningQuestions.audio: Having a plan is no guarantee that it will come true.
opts: 有计划并不能保证它会实现。

listeningQuestions.audio: Whatever twists and turns you meet, be ready for the unexpected.
opts: 无论遇到怎样的曲折,都要为意外做好准备。

listeningQuestions.audio: I'm going to study computer science and build robots one day.
opts: 我打算学计算机科学,将来造机器人。

listeningQuestions.audio: We can only connect the dots of our life by looking backwards.
opts: 我们只能通过回望把人生的点点滴滴连起来。
他把秘密告诉了所有人。

listeningQuestions.audio: The future belongs to those who prepare for it with optimism.
opts: 未来属于那些以乐观去准备的人。

finalReading.passage: Ten years ago, Sophie had no clear idea what her future would look like. She kept learning new skills, stayed open to change, and was never afraid to try unusual paths. Today she runs a small company that builds robots to help elderly people, a job that did not even exist when she was at school.

questions.q: What did Sophie do over those ten years?
options: She kept learning and stayed open to change.
She gave up trying anything new.
She refused to change her early plans.
She waited for others to decide for her.
questions.explanation: 对应短文 'kept learning new skills, stayed open to change' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What is special about Sophie's job today?
options: It is exactly the job she planned at school.
It did not exist when she was young.
It has nothing to do with technology.
It pays her almost no money.
questions.explanation: 末句 'a job that did not even exist when she was at school'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。

units.title: Tuesdays with Morrie

lines.text: I just finished Tuesdays with Morrie. I thought it would be sad, but I feel full of hope.
lines.cn: 我刚读完《相约星期二》。本以为会很悲伤,结果我满怀希望。

lines.text: I felt the same. Morrie was very ill, yet he was never pessimistic.
lines.cn: 我也是。莫里病得很重,却从不悲观。

lines.text: My favourite idea is that our values should be chosen by ourselves, not by society.
lines.cn: 我最喜欢的一点是:我们的价值观应由自己选择,而不是由社会决定。

lines.text: Mine is simpler: we must keep in touch with the good people we love.
lines.cn: 我喜欢的更简单:要和我们所爱的好人保持联系。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 被动语态综合复习(各时态被动 + 非谓语被动)

units.grammarTitle: 被动语态综合复习(各时态被动 + 非谓语被动)

reading.passage: After he became seriously ill, Morrie decided to share everything he had learned about love and life. Every Tuesday his former student came to visit him, and their honest talks were later turned into a book that has moved millions of readers.
reading.passageCn: 在病重之后,莫里决定把自己关于爱与人生所学的一切分享出来。每个星期二,他从前的学生都来探望他,而他们坦诚的谈话后来被写成了一本打动了千百万读者的书。

questions.q: Why did Morrie decide to share his ideas?
opts: Because he wanted to pass on what he had learned.
Because he wanted to become rich.

questions.q: What were their Tuesday talks turned into?

writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写一本书或一个人如何改变了你的生活方式:发生了什么、你学到了什么,至少用两个被动句(如 The book was written by…, I was reminded that…)。

quizQuestions.q: Morrie was slowly ____ by a severe illness.

Morrie taught us to ____ what we already have.

Right now, a new cover ____ for the next edition.
Despite ____ by illness, Morrie stayed cheerful.
Such wisdom must ____ down to the young.

opts: 莫里从窗口观察着每一次季节的变化。
quizQuestions.audio: Morrie observed every change of season from his window.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 彼此相爱,否则就会消亡。
quizQuestions.audio: Love each other, or perish.

listeningQuestions.audio: Morrie is being weakened by a severe illness.
opts: 莫里正被一场重病一点点拖垮。

listeningQuestions.audio: Once you learn how to die, you learn how to live.
opts: 一旦学会面对死亡,你就学会了如何生活。

listeningQuestions.audio: Happiness is found in simple things, not in luxury.
opts: 幸福在于简单的事物,而非奢华。

listeningQuestions.audio: A box of tissues will be needed to read this book.
opts: 读这本书会需要一盒纸巾。

listeningQuestions.audio: We should always keep in touch with good friends.
opts: 我们应当一直和好友保持联系。
他把秘密告诉了所有人。

listeningQuestions.audio: These lessons have been shared with readers around the world.
opts: 这些人生道理已被分享给世界各地的读者。

finalReading.passage: Liang used to spend all his pocket money on the latest phones and shoes, sure that owning more would finally make him happy. Months later, he felt far richer than he ever had while chasing new gadgets.

questions.q: What did Liang believe at first?
options: That owning more things would make him happy.
That money had no value at all.
That his friends were unimportant.
That phones were far too cheap.
questions.explanation: 原文 'sure that owning more would finally make him happy' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Liang feel months later?
options: Richer than when he chased new gadgets.
Poorer and rather unhappy.
Bored with his own family.
Sorry that he had ever changed.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt far richer than he ever had while chasing new gadgets'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Welcome to Dunhuang!

lines.text: Where should we go to see real Chinese culture?
lines.cn: 我们去哪里能看到真正的中国文化?

lines.text: Let's go to Dunhuang, because it is full of ancient caves and murals.
lines.cn: 去敦煌吧,因为那里满是古老的洞窟和壁画。

lines.text: Is it hard to get there?
lines.cn: 去那儿难吗?

lines.text: Not really. If we take the fast train, we can arrive in one day.
lines.cn: 不太难。如果坐高铁,一天就能到。

lines.text: Look up! The whole ceiling is covered with paintings.
lines.cn: 抬头看!整个洞顶都画满了壁画。

lines.text: They are so beautiful that I can hardly believe their age.
lines.cn: 它们如此美丽,我简直不敢相信有这么久的历史。

lines.text: Why is the light so low in here?
lines.cn: 这里的灯光为什么这么暗?

lines.text: The staff keep it low so that the old colours do not fade.
lines.cn: 工作人员把光调暗,以便古老的色彩不会褪去。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 状语从句综合复习(时间/条件/让步/原因/结果/目的)

units.grammarTitle: 状语从句综合复习(时间/条件/让步/原因/结果/目的)

reading.passage: Dunhuang sits on the old Silk Road, where tired travellers once rested in a green oasis. Because so many traders passed through, the small desert city became a busy meeting place for East and West.
reading.passageCn: 敦煌坐落在古老的丝绸之路上,疲惫的旅人曾在这片绿洲歇脚。因为众多商人途经此地,这座沙漠小城成了东西方繁忙的交汇之地。

questions.q: Where does Dunhuang sit?
Why did the city become a busy meeting place?
opts: Because many traders passed through it.

writing.prompt: Write a short note recommending Dunhuang to a foreign friend. Say where it is, what is special about it, and why he or she should visit. Try to use adverbial clauses (if / because / so that / although).
writing.promptCn: 写一段短文,向外国朋友推荐敦煌:它在哪里、有什么特别、为什么值得一去。试着用状语从句(if / because / so that / although)把理由串起来。

quizQuestions.q: The city ____ many sites with protected heritage status.（自豪地拥有)
Thousands of ancient ____ were hidden inside the Library Cave.（手稿)
The painting of Apsaras reached a ____ during the Tang Dynasty.（顶峰)
Dunhuang was a centre of cultural ____ for many centuries.（交流)
____ you look up, you can see the murals on the ceiling of the cave.
____ the city was once so great, it slowly faded from memory.
The cave was ____ dark that we could hardly see the paintings.
Come a little closer ____ you can see the fine details of the painting.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 壁画覆盖了洞窟墙壁巨大的面积。
quizQuestions.audio: The murals cover an enormous area of the cave walls.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 每天只有少数游客可以进入每个洞窟。
quizQuestions.audio: Only a few visitors may enter each cave every day.

listeningQuestions.audio: Dunhuang was the gateway to and from ancient China.
opts: 敦煌是进出古代中国的门户。
敦煌是一座现代工厂城市。
敦煌从来没有商人来过。

listeningQuestions.audio: The Mogao Grottoes were carved out of the rock over a thousand years.
opts: 莫高窟是去年才建成的。
莫高窟历经一千多年从岩石中开凿而成。
莫高窟是用木头搭成的。

listeningQuestions.audio: The Flying Apsaras seem to float across the painted sky.
opts: 飞天仿佛飘浮在彩绘的天空中。

listeningQuestions.audio: In 1900 a Taoist priest discovered the sealed Library Cave.
opts: 藏经洞是一位外国国王建造的。
1900年一位道士发现了被封的藏经洞。

listeningQuestions.audio: Today Dunhuang is a world-class tourist destination.
opts: 如今敦煌是世界级的旅游目的地。
如今敦煌禁止游客进入。

listeningQuestions.audio: The Expo aimed to promote cultural exchange between countries.
opts: 博览会旨在促进各国之间的文化交流。
博览会把游客拒之门外。

finalReading.passage: When Li Wei first visited Dunhuang, she knew almost nothing about its long history. After a guide showed her the painted caves and explained the Silk Road, she began to understand why the small desert city had once been so important. By the end of the day, she felt proud that such treasures belonged to her own country.

questions.q: What was Li Wei's knowledge of Dunhuang's history at first?
options: She had almost no knowledge of it.
She was already an expert on it.
She had studied it for many years.
She had visited the city before.
questions.explanation: 首句说她起初对敦煌历史几乎一无所知 → 几乎不了解;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: What helped her understand why the city mattered?
options: A guide's tour of the caves and talk about the Silk Road.
A book she read on the train home.
A film she watched the night before.
A lesson from her school teacher.
questions.explanation: 第二句说导游带她看洞窟并讲解丝绸之路 → 导游的讲解;其余文中未提。

questions.q: How did she feel by the end of the day?
options: Proud that such treasures were part of her country.
Bored and ready to leave.
Sorry that she had come at all.
Worried about the long journey back.
questions.explanation: 末句说她为这些珍宝属于自己的国家而自豪 → 自豪;其余与原文相反。

units.title: Business Blossoms

lines.text: Have you heard of the woman who grows roses in that quiet valley?
lines.cn: 你听说过那个在静谧山谷里种玫瑰的女人吗?

lines.text: Yes, the chairwoman whose roses are now sold across Asia. She's amazing.
lines.cn: 听过,就是那位玫瑰已卖到亚洲各地的女会长。她太厉害了。

lines.text: The hardest part was the early phase, when few people believed in her.
lines.cn: 最难的是起步阶段,那时很少有人相信她。

lines.text: But she never gave up, which is why she succeeded in the end.
lines.cn: 但她从不放弃,这正是她最终成功的原因。

lines.text: University is the first place where I have to handle money on my own.
lines.cn: 大学是我第一次要自己管钱的地方。

lines.text: Then open an account that has no fees, and save a little each week.
lines.cn: 那就开一个免手续费的账户,每周存一点。

lines.text: What about a credit card, which my friend says is risky?
lines.cn: 信用卡呢?我朋友说那东西有风险。

lines.text: Use it carefully and pay on time, so you never go into debt.
lines.cn: 小心使用、按时还款,这样你就不会负债。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 定语从句综合复习(限制/非限制 · 关代/关副)

units.grammarTitle: 定语从句综合复习(限制/非限制 · 关代/关副)

reading.passage: Zhang Yue once paid little attention to the roses around her home. After studying overseas, she saw their business potential, returned home, and built a flower company whose roses are now sold across Asia.
reading.passageCn: 张悦曾对家乡四周的玫瑰不以为意。出国留学后,她看到了它们的商业潜力,于是回乡创办了一家花卉公司,如今其玫瑰已销往亚洲各地。

questions.q: When did Zhang Yue notice the value of the roses?
opts: When she was a small child.
Before she left her home town.

questions.q: How well does her company do now?
opts: Its roses are sold across Asia.
It sells only in one village.
It grows no roses at all.

writing.prompt: Write a few sentences to introduce a local product you like. Say what it is and where it comes from, describe one special feature, and explain why you recommend it. Try to use attributive clauses (which / who / where / whose).
writing.promptCn: 写几句话介绍一款你喜欢的本地产品:说明它是什么、产自哪里,描述一个特别之处,并解释为什么推荐它。尝试使用定语从句(which / who / where / whose)。

quizQuestions.q: She is now the ____ of her own rose company.(女会长)
This year every worker received a ____ as a reward.(奖金)
Only after returning home did she see the ____ of roses.(潜力)
A part-time job should never ____ with your studies.(妨碍)
This is the valley ____ roses grow wild all year round.
The entrepreneur ____ started the rose farm is now famous.
She decided to grow roses, ____ surprised many people.
I will never forget the day ____ I started my own business.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 起步阶段最大的挑战是说服当地人为她工作。
她一开始就有很多顾客。
村民们立刻就相信了她。
quizQuestions.audio: The biggest challenge at the early phase was to persuade local people to work for her.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 用手机你可以租一辆自行车或租一个房间。
手机不能用来支付任何费用。
共享只适合公司,不适合个人。
quizQuestions.audio: With a phone, you can hire a bike for an hour or rent a room for a night.

listeningQuestions.audio: Zhang Yue is the chairwoman of a company that grows roses in a quiet valley.
opts: 张悦是一家在静谧山谷里种玫瑰的公司的女会长。
张悦从未经营过任何公司。
她的公司只生产化妆品。

listeningQuestions.audio: The workers pick the delicate flowers before sunrise every morning.
opts: 工人们每天清晨在日出前采摘娇嫩的花朵。
花朵是机器自动采摘的。

listeningQuestions.audio: A large company offered to purchase her product and help with its distribution.
opts: 一家大公司提出购买她的产品并帮忙分销。
没有公司愿意买她的产品。
她拒绝把产品卖给任何人。

listeningQuestions.audio: This year she can pay every worker a fair bonus.
opts: 今年她能给每位工人发一笔公道的奖金。
今年公司付不出任何工资。

listeningQuestions.audio: The sharing economy lets people borrow things instead of buying them.
opts: 共享经济让人们借用物品而非购买。
共享经济迫使人们买更多东西。

listeningQuestions.audio: Always pay your bill on time, or your credit score will fall.
opts: 务必按时还款,否则你的信用分会下降。
信用分和还款毫无关系。

finalReading.passage: After leaving her busy city job, Lin opened a small bakery in her home town, where few shops had ever lasted long. She worked from dawn till night and slowly won loyal customers, and within two years her little bakery, whose cakes became famous nearby, was making a steady profit.

questions.q: Where did Lin open her bakery?
options: In the town where she had grown up.
In the big city she worked in.
Next to her old office.
In a foreign country.
questions.explanation: 短文说她在 home town 开店,'回到家乡小镇'的转述。

questions.q: What had been true of shops in that town before?
options: Few of them had stayed in business for long.
All of them were very successful.
They were all bakeries.
They sold only flowers.
questions.explanation: 对 'where few shops had ever lasted long' 的转述。

questions.q: How was the bakery doing after two years?
options: It was earning money steadily.
It had already closed down.
It was losing money fast.
It had moved to the city.
questions.explanation: 对 'was making a steady profit' 的转述,而非照抄。

units.title: The Mysteries of the Maya

lines.text: Look at this model of a Maya pyramid. How did they build it without metal tools?
lines.cn: 看这个玛雅金字塔的模型。他们没有金属工具是怎么建起来的?

lines.text: That's exactly what still puzzles experts today.
lines.cn: 这正是至今仍让专家们困惑的地方。

lines.text: And why did they leave such amazing cities?
lines.cn: 他们又为什么离弃了如此了不起的城市呢?

lines.text: Many believe that years of drought finally drove them away.
lines.cn: 许多人认为是连年干旱最终迫使他们离开。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 名词性从句综合复习(主语/宾语/表语/同位语从句)

units.grammarTitle: 名词性从句综合复习(主语/宾语/表语/同位语从句)

reading.passage: The Maya were one of the most advanced peoples of the ancient Americas. They built great cities and carefully studied the stars, yet within a few generations these cities were abandoned. Why this happened is still one of history's greatest mysteries.
reading.passageCn: 玛雅人是古代美洲最先进的民族之一。他们建造了伟大的城市,并认真研究星象,然而在短短几代人之内,这些城市便被弃置。这一切为何发生,至今仍是历史上最大的谜团之一。

questions.q: What did the Maya build and study?
opts: Great cities, and they studied the stars.

questions.q: What happened to their cities?
opts: They were rebuilt entirely in gold.
They were abandoned within a few generations.
They were moved to the coast.

questions.q: How does the passage describe the collapse?
opts: As one of history's greatest mysteries.
As a well-known and simple fact.
As a very small, minor event.
As a problem of recent years.

writing.prompt: In about 60 words, write a short article about one mystery from history that interests you. Say why it is mysterious and what you think might explain it. Try to use noun clauses such as 'The fact that…' and 'What caused…'.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一篇短文,介绍一个让你感兴趣的历史谜团。说明它为何神秘,以及你认为可能的解释。尽量使用 'The fact that…'、'What caused…' 等名词性从句。

quizQuestions.q: '金字塔'对应的英文是?
'离弃、逃离(城市)'用哪个动词?
'否定、不予考虑(某理论)'用哪个词?
'(因无人照料而)衰落败落'对应哪个短语?
____ caused the Maya to vanish is still a mystery.（句首作主语)
The fact ____ they had no metal tools amazes us.（同位语)
We are not sure ____ a drought destroyed them or not.
The Maya recorded ____ they saw in the night sky.
听句子选中文:
opts: 茂密的丛林慢慢掩埋了空荡的城市。
quizQuestions.audio: The thick jungle slowly buried the empty cities.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 好奇心一直推动人类去探索。
quizQuestions.audio: Curiosity has always pushed humankind to explore.

listeningQuestions.audio: The Maya built tall stone pyramids deep in the jungle.
opts: 玛雅人在丛林深处建起高大的石头金字塔。

listeningQuestions.audio: No one has fully read the ancient Maya writing.
opts: 至今没人能完全读懂古老的玛雅文字。
玛雅文字非常容易读懂。
玛雅文字是欧洲人写的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Years of drought may have caused the cities to collapse.
opts: 连年干旱也许导致了城市的衰亡。

listeningQuestions.audio: Brave explorers learn to subdue their fear of the unknown.
opts: 勇敢的探险者学会克制对未知的恐惧。

listeningQuestions.audio: We have better maps of the Moon than of the deep sea bed.
opts: 我们对月球的地图比对深海海床的更详尽。
我们已绘制了全部海床地图。
海床比月球更容易绘制。

listeningQuestions.audio: China's deep-sea vessel once dived over seven thousand metres.
opts: 中国的潜水器从未下潜。
中国的潜水器曾下潜超过七千米。

finalReading.passage: For hundreds of years, the ruined Maya cities lay hidden under the thick jungle, forgotten by the wider world. When explorers finally cut through the trees and found them, they were amazed that such a skilled people could have vanished so completely. Even now, scientists still argue about exactly what drove the Maya from their homes.

questions.q: Why were the Maya cities forgotten for so long?
options: Thick jungle had grown over and hidden them.
They had been built deep underwater.
They were never actually completed.
Their people had carried them abroad.
questions.explanation: 原文 'lay hidden under the thick jungle, forgotten by the wider world' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What do scientists still argue about today?
options: How to grow crops in the jungle.
Exactly what made the Maya leave their cities.
When the Maya calendar was first invented.
Where to build the next stone pyramid.
questions.explanation: 末句 'argue about exactly what drove the Maya from their homes' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: The Call of the Challenger

lines.text: Hurry up! The rocket must be about to launch.
lines.cn: 快点!火箭一定快要发射了。

lines.text: Look at all that smoke and fire — the crew must be inside already.
lines.cn: 看那些浓烟和火焰——机组人员一定已经在里面了。

lines.text: They are so brave. I could never stay that calm.
lines.cn: 他们真勇敢,我绝不可能那么镇定。

lines.text: One day we should join a space camp and train like them.
lines.cn: 总有一天我们该去太空营,像他们一样训练。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 情态动词综合复习(义务/推测/虚拟 must/should/might have done)

units.grammarTitle: 情态动词综合复习(义务/推测/虚拟 must/should/might have done)

reading.passage: The space shuttle Challenger carried an ordinary teacher who hoped to give lessons from orbit. Tragically, it exploded soon after take-off and all seven crew members were lost. Yet people were determined to keep exploring space.
reading.passageCn: 挑战者号航天飞机载着一名普通教师,她希望在太空轨道上讲课。不幸的是,它在起飞后不久爆炸,七名机组人员全部遇难。然而人们仍下定决心要继续探索太空。

questions.q: Who did the Challenger carry into space?
How did people respond after the disaster?
opts: They decided to keep exploring space.

writing.prompt: Write a few sentences about a space hero you admire. Say what they did and why their courage inspires you. Try to use modal verbs such as 'must' and 'could'.
writing.promptCn: 写几句话介绍一位你敬佩的航天英雄:他/她做了什么,为什么他们的勇气激励了你。试着用上 must、could 等情态动词。

quizQuestions.q: Without gravity, an astronaut's bones and ____ slowly grow weak.
An ordinary teacher was about to become the first ____ in space.
After the disaster, the shuttle flights were ____ for nearly three years.
Through the telescope she watched the ____ surface of the Moon.
The lights are on and I hear voices, so the crew ____ be inside now.
You ____ checked the oxygen tank earlier; now it is far too late.
All astronauts ____ pass a strict medical check before any space flight.
He ____ have seen the comet last night; the sky was full of cloud.
Listen: 'The Challenger exploded just over a minute after take-off.' When did it explode?
opts: Just over a minute after take-off.
After a whole day in space.
quizQuestions.audio: The Challenger exploded just over a minute after take-off.

quizQuestions.q: Listen: 'Christa hoped to rekindle young people's interest in space.' What did Christa hope to do?
opts: Renew young people's interest in space.
quizQuestions.audio: Christa hoped to rekindle young people's interest in space.

listeningQuestions.audio: The Challenger carried the first civilian, an ordinary teacher, into space.
opts: 挑战者号把第一位平民——一名普通教师——送入太空。
挑战者号只运送了一些机器。
挑战者号从未离开过地面。
挑战者号载着一群游客去海边。

listeningQuestions.audio: Millions of families watched the first lunar landing on television.
opts: 数百万家庭在电视上观看了首次登月。
只有少数科学家知道这次登月。
人们在报纸上读到登月已是多年以后。
登月只是一部电影里的情节。

listeningQuestions.audio: Without gravity, astronauts must strap themselves down to sleep safely.
opts: 没有重力,宇航员必须把自己绑住才能安全睡觉。
宇航员在太空睡得比在地球更香。
宇航员睡觉时要开着所有的灯。

listeningQuestions.audio: A powerful telescope lets us see galaxies billions of light years away.
opts: 强大的望远镜让我们看到数十亿光年外的星系。
望远镜只能用来看近处的山。
望远镜让星星看起来更小了。
望远镜只在白天才能使用。

listeningQuestions.audio: We must keep reaching for the stars, no matter how distant they seem.
opts: 无论星辰多么遥远,我们都必须继续追寻。
星星太远了,我们应该放弃。
我们只该研究地球上的事。

listeningQuestions.audio: Real courage means doing the right thing even when you are afraid.
opts: 真正的勇气是即使害怕也去做对的事。
勇气就是从不感到害怕。
勇敢的人从不面对危险。
害怕的时候就该立刻逃走。

finalReading.passage: When Lin was ten, she stayed up late one night to watch a rocket carry astronauts into space. The bright flame and the great roar filled her with wonder, and there and then she decided that she too would one day work in space science. Years later, as a young engineer helping to build a telescope, she felt proud that a single evening had set the course of her whole life.

questions.q: Why did Lin stay up late as a child?
options: To watch a rocket launch carrying astronauts.
To finish her homework on time.
To say goodbye to her friends.
To wait for the morning Sun.
questions.explanation: 原文'watch a rocket carry astronauts into space'的转述;其余与原文无关。

questions.q: What did the launch make Lin decide?
options: To stop watching television.
That she would work in space science one day.
To move to another country.
To give up studying at school.
questions.explanation: 原文'she too would one day work in space science'的转述(短文中段)。

questions.q: How did Lin feel about that evening years later?
options: Proud that it had shaped her whole life.
Sorry that she had ever seen it.
Bored by the memory of it.
Afraid of rockets ever since.
questions.explanation: 末句'proud that a single evening had set the course of her whole life'的转述(短文末尾,覆盖不同位置)。
